article.articleHeadline: Detectan el primer caso en Colombia del clado Ib de mpox o viruela símica, pero no se alarme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of mpox clade Ib detected in Colombia, but don’t panic.
article.articleSummary: Colombia confirms its first mpox (monkeypox) clade Ib case, detected in Antioquia and confirmed by molecular techniques targeting Ib-specific regions. Previously, all Colombian mpox cases were clade II; from 2022 through epidemiological week 13 of 2026, 4,825 clade II cases have been reported. The finding does not indicate population-wide risk or active community transmission; no additional cases or transmission chains have been identified, and surveillance with field epidemiology and contact tracing continues with territorial authorities and the National Institute of Health. Clade Ib was declared a World Health Organization Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024 due to rising mpox activity, notably near the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Mpox is caused by Orthopoxvirus; clades I and II differ in transmission and severity. Colombia's Expanded Immunization Program provides mpox vaccination (two doses) for adults >18 with exposure (health workers, people living with HIV). Symptoms include fever, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and rash; seek care, avoid contact, maintain hygiene, and practice safe sex; limit sexual partners.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアでmpox（猿痘）クレイドIbの初症例を検出、しかし慌てる必要はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当（異常性、流行リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言中のクレイドIbの新規検出は公衆衛生上重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: コロンビアはDRCと対象国リストに含まれていないため、記事サマリーに明記されているDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。クレイドIbは2024年8月にWHO PHEICに指定されており、DRCでの活動増加と関連している。シグナルは対象地域への関連性があるため PICKUP と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 警惕！泰国类鼻疽疫情今年已确诊732例，死亡23例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant! Thailand's anthrax-like outbreak has 732 confirmed cases and 23 deaths this year.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports an anthrax-like disease outbreak with 732 confirmed cases and 23 deaths this year (Jan 1–Apr 16, 2026). The illness is caused by bacteria found in soil and water; infection can occur through wounds, inhalation of dust, or drinking contaminated water. Symptoms may be acute or chronic and include high fever, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and swelling or abscesses at infection sites. If bacteria enter the bloodstream, severe infection and death may result. High-risk groups include farmers, workers exposed to soil or water, and people with diabetes, kidney disease, thalassemia, or immunosuppression. The government urges protective measures—avoid direct contact with soil and water; wear boots and gloves as needed. Any fever >2 days, dyspnea, or wound infection warrants urgent medical care; timely treatment can cure the disease.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒が必要！タイの抗酸菌様感染症、今年すでに732例が確認され、23例が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。土壌・水由来の環境関連病原体による流行は継続的な集団曝露リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事見出しの「类鼻疽」（Burkholderia pseudomallei感染症/メリオイドーシス）とAPIの「Anthrax」分類に乖離がある可能性があるが、サマリーの臨床像（土壌・水媒介、高熱、呼吸困難、創傷感染）はメリオイドーシスと一致。いずれにせよ環境由来の重篤な細菌感染症であり、リスク評価は変わらない。4月中旬時点で既に732例、死亡23例という高い集団発生規模。農民など高リスク職業集団と基礎疾患保有者に対する感染対策・啓発が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Colombia confirma primer caso de delicado virus; conozca los síntomas y formas de contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colombia Confirms First Case of a Dangerous Virus; Learn the Symptoms and Modes of Transmission.
article.articleSummary: Colombia confirms its first mpox case caused by clade Ib; government states no community transmission and the event remains controlled and under strict surveillance. Since 2022, Colombia has reported 4,825 mpox cases through epidemiological week 13 of 2026, all previously linked to clade II. Immediate actions include field investigations, contact tracing, and coordination with regional authorities to prevent transmission chains. The WHO designated clade Ib as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024 due to spread in Africa, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Colombia continues mpox vaccination for adults over 18 at high exposure (close contacts, multiple sexual partners, exposed health workers, people living with HIV). Symptoms: fever, muscle pain, swollen lymph nodes, and skin lesions; transmission via close contact, including sexual contact. Authorities urge symptoms to seek medical care, practice hygiene, avoid sharing personal items, and pursue safe sex. No additional cases detected.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアが危険なウイルスの最初の症例を確認；症状と感染方法を知る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。新規クレード（Ib）の初確認、アフリカでの急速な拡大と関連、WHOの国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態指定済み。
triage.notes: コロンビアでのMpox初症例報告であるが、コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。記事ではDRCでのクレードIbの拡大背景が重要な文脈として述べられている。DRCは対象国に該当するため、この関連情報を持つシグナルとして認識される。クレードIbはWHOが2024年8月に国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定済み。

article.articleHeadline: India contiene brote del virus Nipah luego de confirmar 2 casos de la enfermedad altamente mortal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India contains Nipah virus outbreak after confirming two cases of the highly fatal disease
article.articleSummary: Two Nipah virus cases were confirmed in West Bengal, India, prompting a rapid containment effort. Authorities reported immediate escalation of surveillance, laboratory testing, and field investigations, with 196 identified contacts all testing negative so far; no further health updates on the patients were provided. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with no approved vaccine and a high case-fatality range (40-75%). Common symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and respiratory illness; severe disease can cause seizures, encephalitis, and coma. Fruit bats are the natural hosts and the probable source of human infections. Nipah was first detected in 1998 (Malaysia); India’s first outbreak occurred in West Bengal in 2001. Large Kerala outbreaks followed in 2018 (at least 17 deaths) and in 2023 (two deaths). Indian health authorities say the situation remains under permanent surveillance and all necessary public health measures are active to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: インドがニパウイルスの流行を封じ込め、高い致死率の病気の2件の確認後
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス（致死率40-75%）の確認症例により、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「重症度の懸念」が該当し、歴史的に流行地域のインドでの再発生であるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは西ベンガル州での2件の確認症例が主要な報告対象。マレーシア（1998年初検出地）も過去の文脈で言及されるが、現在の発生地はインドのみ。ニパウイルスは高い致死率（40-75%）と人獣共通感染症の性質、予防接種ワクチンの不在により、公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。インドは2001年、2018年、2023年に複数の流行を経験している。196名の接触者が全員陰性という迅速な接触追跡対応は評価されるが、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Detectan en Antioquia el primer caso de variante viruela símica en Colombia: esto dijo MinSalud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antioquia detects the first case of a monkeypox variant in Colombia: this is what the Ministry of Health said.
article.articleSummary: Antioquia, Colombia reports its first mpox (monkeypox) case belonging to clade Ib, marking the first detection of this variant in the country. Identification was achieved via molecular techniques targeting clade Ib–specific regions to strengthen diagnostic and surveillance capacity. Previously, all Colombian mpox cases were clade II; from 2022 through epidemiological week 13 of 2026 there are 4,825 confirmed clade II cases. The new clade Ib finding does not alter overall population risk as no community transmission has been observed. Strict follow-up is underway; no additional cases or transmission chains identified to date, with ongoing field epidemiology, contact tracing, and public health surveillance coordinated with the National Institute of Health. Clade Ib was declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024 due to rising mpox activity regionally and globally, with prior outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: アンティオキア県でコロンビア初のサル痘変異株を検出：保健省の声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準で複数該当、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのClade Ibの新規検出であり、地域的な疫学的関心が高い。
triage.notes: コロンビアはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただし記事でDRC（対象国）との関連が言及されており、Clade Ibはアフリカ地域での発生が背景にあるため、DRCのみをピックアップ対象として列挙。IHR基準の国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクはこの新規変異株の地理的拡大可能性に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: KLB Campak Ditetapkan Lebih Awal di Cirebon, Dua Balita Meninggal, Kasus Terus Meningkat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak declared earlier in Cirebon, two toddlers died, cases continue to rise.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak declared a Public Health Emergency (KLB) in Cirebon city, Indonesia on February 20, 2026 after epidemiological review. Two toddlers died from measles, linked to comorbidity and incomplete immunization. The surge began in late December 2025 (week 53) and has since spread to all five districts and 22 subdistricts (kelurahan) of Cirebon; five districts report cases, but not all kelurahan. Authorities issued surveillance alerts and coordinated with the Education Department, launching mass immunization targeting ages 9 months to 13 years at schools, posyandu, puskesmas, and other sites. Initial vaccination coverage was 84.9%, rising to 94.8% with follow-up rounds. Officials attribute the outbreak to waning community immunity after COVID-19 and misinformation on social media, noting most cases occur among children with incomplete immunization.

triage.headline_ja: シレボンで麻疹アウトブレイク宣言、乳幼児2人死亡、患者数増加続く
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹アウトブレイクが公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を呈しており、死亡例を伴う異常な拡大が確認されている。インドネシア（対象国）での確認的なイベントであり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: シレボン市での麻疹アウトブレイク（2026年2月20日公式宣言）。2025年12月下旬から発生し、全5地区22ケルラハンに拡大。死亡例（乳幼児2人）と免疫接種不完全者の多発が特徴。当局による予防接種キャンペーン実施済み（接種率94.8%）。COVID-19後の集団免疫低下とSNSでの誤情報が原因と指摘。

article.articleHeadline: 香港新增1例麻疹病例　患者在機場工作 | ETtoday大陸新聞 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports one new measles case; the patient works at the airport.
article.articleSummary: Measles in Hong Kong: A locally acquired case involving a 30-year-old man working at the airport. He developed myalgia on April 14, fever and sore throat on April 15, and a rash on April 17, and was admitted to Caritas Medical Centre after a Mong Kok clinic visit; measles virus RNA tested positive. The patient, who lives alone and did not travel during incubation, is a contact of a prior measles case at the same airport workplace. Contact tracing is ongoing for the clinic and workplace. As of 5:00 pm on April 18, 100 clinic attendees and 162 workplace-related staff have been identified as close contacts and are being managed to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で麻疹の新規患者1例報告 - 患者は空港で勤務
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は予防可能な疾患であり、香港では高いワクチン接種率により重症化リスクは低いと考えられる。ただし空港という人流が多い場所での発生と既知患者との関連が認められ、接触者追跡が進行中であるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での麻疹発生であり、China (1814991) に含める。空港従業員への感染であり、多数の接触者（100名以上）が特定されている。ただし1例報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上該当していないため PICKUP には至らず。続報にて複数の関連症例や国際的拡大の兆候があれば昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan Warga Sragen Terserang Chikungunya di Masa Pancaroba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of Sragen residents infected with Chikungunya during the Pancaroba period.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 April 2026, 24 residents in Dukuh Gabus Wetan, Gabus Village, Ngrampal District, Sragen Regency, Indonesia have chikungunya, with 13 cases in RT 005 and 11 in RT 006. Reported symptoms include high fever, severe joint pain, body aches, fatigue, and in some cases inability to walk, feverish chills, and red skin rashes. Onset typically occurs 2–7 days after an Aedes aegypti bite, commonly in the late afternoon. Local response includes fogging and environmental cleanup coordinated by Puskesmas Ngrampal; Sragen Health Office (P2P) says no official report yet but is coordinating follow-up. Treatment is symptomatic (fever reducers, pain relief); prevention focuses on vector control, including draining standing water and clearing vegetation to reduce breeding. Authorities aim to contain the outbreak and prevent spread to other areas.

triage.headline_ja: サランゲン県民がパンカロバ期間中にチクングニアに感染 数十名が罹患
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのチクングニア集団発生事例。IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が確認でき、WPROスクリーニングで複数基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）に該当。地域的な対応が開始されており、さらなる拡大リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: チクングニアは蚊媒介性の季節性疾患であり、記事で「パンカロバ期間」（季節の転換期）での発生が報告されている。24例の確認患者（RT005で13例、RT006で11例）が報告され、症状は典型的なチクングニア症状（高熱、関節痛、皮疹）を示している。地域当局による感染症対策（蚊ベクター管理、環境清掃）が既に実施されており、拡大防止への関心が高い。WHOへの正式報告はまだとのことだが、地域保健部門による積極的な対応が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт Шахмарданов указал на уникальную мутационную картину вируса оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert Shakhmardanov pointed to a unique mutational pattern of the Monkeypox virus.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox virus shows a unique mutational pattern in clade Ib, indicating sustained human-to-human transmission, according to Murad Shakhmardanov of the Pyrogov Institute, Moscow. The new variant, first identified in 2023 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, fueled the 2024 African epidemic and has since spread beyond Africa. By late 2025 and early 2026, cases in the United Kingdom and India were linked to a recombinant Monkeypox virus, combining fragments from clades Ib and IIb. This represents a fundamentally new mechanism of Monkeypox evolution. The observation that two such cases were separated by months and geography suggests the recombinant strain is already silently circulating worldwide, with potential for abrupt changes in viral properties through recombination.

triage.headline_ja: シャフマルダノフ専門家がサル痘ウイルスの独特な変異パターンを指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。クレード1b由来の新規組換体の全世界的な循環が示唆され、感染症危機管理の観点から重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはロシア（モスクワ）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではロシアでの実際の確認事例についての明確な記述がない。専門家の見解・分析に関するものと判断し、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCとインドは記事で明確に言及されているため含める。クレード1bの組換体型が2023年DRC初出後、2024年のアフリカ流行を経由して2025年末～2026年初にUK・インドで確認された点が重要。全世界的な潜在的循環との指摘は、今後の蔓延予測に関わる重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan cảnh báo khẩn về dịch "sốt đất": 732 ca nhiễm, 23 trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand issues urgent warning about the 'earth fever' outbreak: 732 cases, 23 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or 'earth fever,' is causing a major outbreak in Thailand with 732 cases and 23 deaths since Jan 1, 2026, reports as of Apr 18, 2026. The northeast region is hit hardest; Khon Kaen Province has 68 cases and 2 deaths in its jurisdiction. The disease is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei found in soil and standing water, transmitted to humans via skin wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust, or use of untreated water. High-risk groups include agricultural workers, people aged 50 and older, and individuals with diabetes or kidney disease. Public health authorities urge wearing protective gear (boots, gloves) for at‑risk individuals and seeking prompt medical care for high fever or related symptoms, as early treatment is often curative. Monitoring continues nationwide by the Ministry of Public Health.

triage.headline_ja: タイが「土地熱」の流行について緊急警告：732例、23死亡例
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスの大規模流行（732例、23死亡）がタイで報告されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理課題が確認される。フルRRAに進めるべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 2026年1月1日以降732例、死亡23例というメリオイドーシスの大規模流行がタイで発生。患者層は農業労働者、50歳以上、糖尿病・腎臓病患者など易感染性集団が主体。Burkholderia pseudomalleiは土壌・停滞水に広く分布する環境病原体であり、長期暴露と地域拡大リスクが高い。タイ公衆衛生省による全国監視体制が構築されており、早期発見・治療で治癒率が高いとの記載があるが、感染源（環境中の病原体）が広範囲に存在するため管理が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Outono mantém riscos invisíveis: parasitas, dermatites e febre maculosa exigem atenção contínua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn brings invisible risks: parasites, dermatitis, and Rocky Mountain spotted fever require ongoing attention.
article.articleSummary: Autumn maintains risk for pets as fleas, ticks, and dermatologic issues persist and may intensify. In Brazil, tick exposure remains a concern even after summer, with experts urging continued parasite prevention year-round. From 2013–2023, Brazil recorded 2,359 cases of Rocky Mountain spotted fever, a 62% increase over the period, with the star tick as the principal vector; transmission can extend to humans when pets bring ticks indoors. Veterinary specialist Camila Camalionte (Elanco) warns that pausing antiparasitics after summer is risky, as autumn’s risk profile shifts but does not disappear. Climate change is reshaping parasite seasonality, leading to year-round flea and tick activity and tougher control. The star tick’s larval stage, micuim, is nearly invisible, increasing infestation risk; skin sensitivity and dermatitis are noted concerns as temperatures fall.

triage.headline_ja: 秋は見えない危険をもたらす：寄生虫、皮膚炎、ロッキー山紅斑熱は継続的な注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでロッキー山紅斑熱の長期的増加傾向（2013～2023年に62%増加、計2,359例）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）で複数該当する懸念がある。ただし記事は獣医学的予防啓発が主題で、現在の急性的な集団発生の兆候は明示されていないため、情報の確認と継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は秋季の季節的リスク啓発が主目的で、現在進行中の集団発生の報告ではない。ただしロッキー山紅斑熱の10年間の62%増加という長期トレンド、気候変動による寄生虫の季節性変化、人間への伝播リスク（ペットが媒介）が報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさが複数該当するため、ブラジル国内の現在の疫学状況確認と続報監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: IDAI Ingatkan Bahaya Reemerging Disease Imunisasi Campak dan Polio Harus Masif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAI Warns of the Dangers of Reemerging Diseases: Measles and Polio Immunization Must Be Massively Implemented.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's IDAI warns of reemerging infectious diseases, notably measles and polio, across the country as of 19 April 2026. Dr. Piprim Basarah Yanuarso emphasizes vaccines’ historical effectiveness in suppressing transmission, citing polio control since the 1960s. Measles outbreaks (Kejadian Luar Biasa, KLB) have emerged due to declining vaccination coverage. Because measles is highly contagious, achieving herd immunity requires coverage above 95%. Social challenges include anti-vaccine misinformation circulating on social media. IDAI also criticizes government emphasis on tertiary care and hospital construction, urging strengthening primary health services: revitalization of Posyandu with trained cadres and adequate incentives; optimization of Puskesmas to focus on promotive-preventive care; and strict surveillance of immunization administration to align field data with reality. The message is a wake-up call to intensify mass immunization campaigns to protect children from measles and safeguard polio gains.

triage.headline_ja: IDAI（インドネシア小児科医会）がウイルス再興感染症の危機を警告：麻疹とポリオの予防接種を大規模に実施する必要がある
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹とポリオの再興が報告され、異常性（ワクチン接種率低下による再興）と重症度（麻疹は高い感染性、ポリオは脊髄性小児麻痺リスク）があり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。政府・学会レベルの警告が存在し、国際的関心も高まる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 麻疹とポリオは両者ともワクチン予防可能疾患であり、ワクチン接種率低下による再興は公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。IDAI（国内医学団体）が直接警告を発出しており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。ただし現時点で具体的な症例数や死亡数は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Čína hlásí nárůst nemocných: Nový virus způsobuje slepotu!  - AHA.cz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China reports a rise in cases: A new virus causes blindness!
article.articleSummary: A novel virus linked to aquatic animals, CMNV, is causing rising cases in China with reports of POH-VAU—a severe eye inflammation marked by extreme intraocular pressure that can lead to blindness. Analyses of cases from 2022–2025 identified CMNV in about seventy Chinese patients; the outbreak centers on terrestrial humans acquiring infection from water-dwelling creatures, a first described cross-species event. Approximately 75% of affected individuals are fishermen who handle aquatic wildlife without gloves, consistent with exposure to the virus, which has been detected in 49 marine species worldwide. First cases outside China have emerged, indicating potential international spread. Laboratory confirmation and epidemiological work have traced the infection source to aquatic life; the report notes ongoing outbreaks and surveillance but does not provide mortality data or human-to-human transmission details beyond environmental exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で患者数増加を報告：新しいウイルスが失明を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 未知の病原体（CMNV）による新規感染症イベント。重症度が高く（失明を引き起こす眼炎症）、国際的拡大の兆候あり、公衆衛生影響が深刻である。IHR基準3項目、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は未知の水生動物由来ウイルス（CMNV）による新規感染症を報告。2022-2025年で約70症例が確認され、75%が水産業従事者である。既に中国外での症例出現が報告されており、国際拡大リスクが高い。ただし死亡率およびヒト-ヒト感染の詳細情報は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 281.984 Anak di Aceh Tidak Pernah Diimunisasi dan Rentan Kena Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 281,984 Children in Aceh Have Never Been Immunized and Are At Risk of Measles
article.articleSummary: 281,984 children in Aceh have never completed a full immunization schedule from 2021–2025, leaving them vulnerable to measles. Districts with the highest numbers are Pidie (34,182), Aceh Utara (31,491), and Bireuen (30,302). Aceh experiences about 5,000 measles cases annually, with 724 cases reported from January–March 2026. Nationally in early 2026, Aceh’s rate of complete immunization is around 1.9–2%, ranking 37th of 38 provinces; Papua Pegunungan is lower at 0.1%. Low uptake is attributed to parental hesitancy and fear of side effects. The Dinas Kesehatan Aceh (Dinkes) and local governments are intensifying outreach, aligning health-post vaccination drives (posyandu) to reach the 281,984 children, with improvements seen in Aceh Tengah and Aceh Tenggara. Authorities are targeting low-coverage districts—Pidie, Bireuen, Aceh Jaya, and Aceh Besar—for 2026 efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アチェ州で28万1,984人の子どもが予防接種を受けておらず、麻疹感染のリスクがある
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・アチェ州における麻疹の流行リスクが高い。予防接種率の著しい低さ（1.9～2%）と年間5,000例の麻疹患者発生、2026年初頭の724例報告が公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す。異常な予防接種率の低さと地域的な流行易感染人口の存在が懸念される。
triage.notes: アチェ州の異常に低い予防接種率（全国で37位の1.9～2%）は構造的な公衆衛生上の課題を示唆している。年間5,000例の麻疹患者数と28万人超の未接種児童のいずれもが都市・農村の地理的な格差と親の予防接種躊躇を反映している。当局の対応が進行中であることは認識されるが、マスクなしで続く流行リスクは顕著。

article.articleHeadline: ಚಿಕನ್‌ ಪ್ರಿಯರೇ ಎಚ್ಚರ! ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿಗೂ ಬಂತು H5N1 ಹಕ್ಕಿ ಜ್ವರ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chicken lovers, beware! H5N1 bird flu has reached Bengaluru as well.
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed in Bengaluru, Karnataka, at a Mattakuru poultry center in the Hesaraghatta area. On April 14 infection was detected; by April 16 authorities declared a 3 km containment zone and a 10 km surveillance belt around the village. A culling operation removed 7,444 chickens, disposed of over 14,000 eggs, and 2,250 kg of poultry feed under veterinary supervision. Surveillance will cover two villages within 3 km (3,422 people) and 17 villages within 3–10 km (22,395 people). PPE kits, masks, oseltamivir, viral transport medium, and throat swabs will be available at Hesaraghatta and Sonnenahalli PHCs; poultry sheds and shops will be inspected. Higher temperatures may heighten transmission. Human symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, and breathing difficulties. Public guidance: cook poultry and eggs thoroughly (>70°C), avoid contact with raw meat, wash hands, and wear masks. Chennai bird-flu scare noted in the report.

triage.headline_ja: チキン好きの方へ注意！H5N1鳥インフルエンザがベンガルールにも到達
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人工感染リスク、異常/予想外な地域での確認、複数都市での検出、そして管理可能性の課題により、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。公衆衛生上の重要な懸念。
triage.notes: H5N1確認は2026年4月14日。ベンガルール（カルナータカ州）での初検出で、チェンナイでも懸念報告あり。7,444羽の鶏を殺処分、14,000個以上の卵を処分。3km隔離ゾーン（3,422人）と3-10km監視帯（22,395人）が設定。気温上昇により伝播リスク増加の懸念。人への感染リスクが存在し、公衆衛生対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 上海印发媒介白纹伊蚊预防控制指南，这种蚊子为何被重视？_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shanghai issues guidelines for the prevention and control of the Aedes albopictus vector; why is this mosquito being prioritized?
article.articleSummary: Shanghai issued the 2026 edition of the Shanghai Aedes albopictus Prevention and Control Guidelines to curb dengue and chikungunya risk from the global spread of vector-borne diseases, including outbreaks in Southeast Asia and South America. Shanghai currently detects only Aedes albopictus, not Aedes aegypti, and emphasizes a whole-society approach with cross‑sector responsibilities for routine vector control in key venues such as shopping centers, markets, schools, elderly homes, construction sites, tourist attractions, hotels, parks, and transit hubs. A new Administrative Punishment Baseline (effective 2026-03-01) fines 1,000–5,000 yuan for improper garbage disposal or standing water; penalties apply if institutions lack designated staff or mosquito facilities. The program is year‑round, with overwintering (Dec–Mar), spring (Apr–May), and peak season (Jun–Nov) phases. In 2026 Shanghai upgrades surveillance to space‑time epidemiology with routine, intensified, and emergency tiers, weekly Ae. albopictus monitoring, and IoT/AI-based counting.

triage.headline_ja: 上海、ヒトスジシマカ媒介蚊の予防・制御ガイドラインを発布；なぜこの蚊が重視されているのか？
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とチクングニアのリスク対応を目的とした公式ガイドラインの発布であり、公衆衛生上の関心がある。ただし、実際の患者発生の報告ではなく、あくまで予防的対策であるため、現時点では情報が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事はシャンハイ市によるガイドラインの発布に関する情報で、東南アジアや南米での流行を背景としているが、シャンハイ市内での具体的な患者発生の報告がない。ベクター制御の強化という予防措置であり、現在の重症度・罹患者数は不明。スクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、実際の患者数・重症度のデータが欠けており、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Биологический щит взломан: учёные подтвердили изменение структуры ДНК-вируса оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Biological shield breached: scientists confirm a change in the DNA structure of the monkeypox virus.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox virus has breached the human immune perimeter and begun evolving rapidly, moving from a wildlife zoonosis to a human-adapted pathogen. Indian researchers analyzed 40 samples in April 2026 and identified an upgraded lineage that blocks interferon signaling, effectively concealing invasion from T cells. Molecular dating of subclade IIb shows the evolutionary rate jumped five to sixfold, with the acceleration beginning around 2016 and intensifying by 2026. The virus has transitioned into human populations, driving intense selection for the most fit variants. The pathogen now co-opts host APOBEC3-mediated DNA damage, turning immune edits into catalysts for more resilient strains. Scientists are prioritizing blocking the viral mechanisms of immune evasion, including direct targeting of viral enzymes. While not a single outbreak source, the findings underscore the need for reinforced defenses at home and continued personal vigilance against threats.

triage.headline_ja: 生物学的防御が破られた：科学者たちがサル痘ウイルスのDNA構造の変化を確認
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの重大な進化（免疫回避能の獲得、感染力増加）とインドでの検証、国際的拡大リスク、および公衆衛生への深刻な影響がIHR基準2つ以上に該当し、WPRO基準でも複数項目が該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月時点の将来予測シナリオであるが、インドの研究者による40サンプルの分析とサブクレード IIb の進化学的分析が記述されている。ウイルスが人間に適応した病原体へ移行し、免疫回避機構を獲得している点が特に懸念される。配信元がロシアメディア（Pravda）であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Власти Таиланда предупреждают о росте случаев мелиоидоза и призывают группы риска соблюдать меры предосторожности - Pattaya Mail
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thai authorities warn of rising melioidosis cases and urge at-risk groups to take precautions - Pattaya Mail
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports rising melioidosis cases nationwide, with 732 cases and 23 deaths from January through mid-April. In Region 7, including Khon Kaen province, 68 cases and 2 deaths have been recorded. Most patients are over 50 years old. Melioidosis is caused by bacteria in soil and water and infects via exposed wounds, inhalation, or ingestion of contaminated water. Symptoms range from fever and shortness of breath to infected wounds and abscesses; severe cases can lead to bloodstream infection. Health authorities urge at-risk groups—farmers, agricultural workers, and people with chronic diseases—to minimize contact with soil and water or use protective gear. Anyone with prolonged fever, respiratory symptoms, or infection signs should seek prompt medical care, as early treatment lowers risk of serious complications.

triage.headline_ja: タイ当局がメリオイドーシス患者数の増加について警告し、ハイリスク層に予防措置の遵守を呼びかけ - パタヤメール
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」に該当（累積732例・死亡23例、国内広がり）。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。対象国タイで確認された感染症事象としてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月19日配信（将来日付のため確認推奨）。メリオイドーシスは環境由来感染症で、特に農業従事者など特定リスク層に高い。国内1月〜4月中旬で732例、23死亡例は同疾患の重大性と拡大傾向を示す。地域的には Region 7（コンケン県含む）で記録的な患者数。

article.articleHeadline: Thailands Gesundheitsbehörden warnen vor steigenden Melioidose-Fällen und rufen Risikogruppen zu Vorsicht auf - Pattaya Mail
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's health authorities warn of rising melioidosis cases and urge at-risk groups to exercise caution - Pattaya Mail
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports rising melioidosis cases, with 732 cases and 23 deaths from January to mid-April 2026 nationwide. Health Region 7, including Khon Kaen Province, registered 68 cases and 2 deaths. Most infections affect people aged 50 and older. Melioidosis is caused by bacteria found in soil and water; transmission occurs via open wounds, inhalation, or consumption of contaminated water. Symptoms range from fever and respiratory symptoms to infected wounds and abscesses; severe cases can lead to sepsis. Authorities urge at-risk groups—farmers, agricultural workers, and people with chronic illnesses—to avoid direct contact with soil and water or wear protective clothing when exposure is unavoidable. Those with persistent fever, respiratory symptoms, or signs of infection should seek prompt medical care, as early treatment reduces the risk of severe complications.

triage.headline_ja: タイの保健当局が増加するメリオイドーシス症例について警告し、リスク層に注意を呼びかけ - パタヤメール
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスの増加は異常かつ予想外であり、2026年1月～4月中旬に732症例・23死亡という重症度と、農民など広範な人口層への長期曝露リスクがWPRO基準を満たす。国家レベルの警告と公衆衛生対応がフルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: 2026年のメリオイドーシス流行はタイの重要な公衆衛生イベント。土壌・水環境由来の自然発生疾患だが、短期間での症例増加と死亡数がシグナル価値を持つ。リスク群への公式警告が発出されている。国際的拡大リスクは記事から不明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ngành chăn nuôi chủ động ứng phó nguy cơ nhiễm virus lở mồm, long móng chủng mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock sector proactively responds to the risk of infection with a new strain of foot-and-mouth disease virus.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease virus SAT-1, a highly virulent FMD strain, threatens Vietnam as neighboring China reports SAT-1 outbreaks in Xinjiang and Gansu. Vietnam has not yet seen SAT-1 domestically, but officials warn the risk is high. Mortality in cattle is 5–10%, potentially 20–50% depending on health; pigs are most affected, with adults about 20% and piglets 50–80%. Vietnam faces gaps: no SAT-1 antibodies in livestock; existing multivalent vaccines do not protect SAT-1. Importing single-valent SAT-1 vaccine could take up to six months and cost around 40,000 VND per dose. Authorities direct emergency vaccine import, rapid test development, tighter border controls, and domestic vaccine research. Measures include strict origin checks, disinfection with lime or iodine/NaOH 2%, and prompt reporting of fever, lethargy, or hoof lesions; do not sell or discard carcasses. Thanh Hoa province culled 30 pigs (>600 kg) to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 畜産業界が新種口蹄疫ウイルス感染リスクに主動的に対応
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）SAT-1株という高病原性新規株がベトナムに迫る直前の脅威段階にあり、中国での発生確認とベトナムでの未発生だが高リスク状況は、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。ベトナムが緊急対応を開始している状況から、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: SAT-1株は既存多価ワクチンで保護されず、ベトナムは国内でまだ検出されていないが、隣接する中国（新疆・甘粛）での発生により高リスク状況。動物疾患だが家畜産業への経済的影響が大きく、公開情報では報告体制が機能している。越境リスク（国境統制強化提示）が明確であり、地域的な流行拡大可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan ban hành cảnh báo bệnh Whitmore sau khi ghi nhận 23 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand issues warning about melioidosis after recording 23 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Whitmore’s disease) triggers concern in Thailand with 732 cases and 23 deaths from January through April 2026. The Northeast region is hardest hit; the Regional Disease Control Office 7 covering Khon Kaen, Maha Sarakham, Roi Et and Kalasin has 68 cases and 2 deaths. People aged 50 and older show the highest incidence. The Ministry of Public Health considers the outbreak alarming and is monitoring closely. Melioidosis is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei in soil and water, entering the body via skin wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust, or drinking contaminated water. High-risk groups include farmers and others with frequent soil/water exposure, and those with weakened immune systems or chronic conditions. Authorities urge protective footwear and gloves, prompt medical evaluation for fever, shortness of breath, chest tightness, or wound infection to prevent severe sepsis.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、メリオイドーシス(ホイットモア病)で23人の死亡を記録した後に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。732症例23死亡の相当な規模の発生であり、地域当局による公式警告と監視が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、2026年1月～4月にタイ全体で732症例、23死亡を報告。東北部地域（カラシン県、ロイエット県等）が最も被影響。50歳以上に高い罹患率。メリオイドーシスは環境中（土壌・水）のBurkholderia pseudomalleiが原因であり、農民や土壌/水への曝露が多い層及び免疫低下患者が高リスク。公衆衛生省が深刻と評価し監視中。

article.articleHeadline: รู้จัก 'โรคไข้ดิน' กลุ่มเสี่ยง สาเหตุ หากมีอาการเหล่านี้ต้องรีบพบแพทย์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Know About the 'Soil Fever' Disease: At-Risk Groups, Causes; If You Have These Symptoms, Seek Medical Attention Promptly.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or soil fever, is described as a dangerous outbreak in Thailand. From January 1 to April 16, 2026, the country reported 732 cases and 23 deaths; the most affected age group is 50 years and older. The Disease Control Office 7 in Khon Kaen Province notes the rising trend. The responsible bacterium is Burkholderia pseudomallei, found in soil and water. Infection occurs when contaminated soil or water contacts broken skin, via inhalation of dust, or by ingesting contaminated water or food. At-risk groups are agricultural workers—farmers, rice farmers, gardeners—and individuals with underlying conditions such as diabetes (highest risk), chronic kidney disease, thalassemia, or immunodeficiency. The disease can be life-threatening if not treated promptly. The article mentions seeking medical attention for symptoms but does not enumerate them, emphasizing early care and awareness.

triage.headline_ja: タイの『土壌熱』疾患について知る：危険群、原因、症状がある場合は医師の診察を急いで受けてください
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは上昇傾向を示す危険な感染症であり、2026年1月1日～4月16日に732例と23死亡例が報告されている。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生への影響（Yes）と異常性（Yes）が明確であり、WPROスクリーニングでも重症度（死亡例あり）、流行しやすさ（農業労働者など多くの人が曝露）が該当する。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはタイにおいて土壌・水中の病原体（Burkholderia pseudomallei）から感染する重大な感染症である。農業労働者や基礎疾患保有者（特に糖尿病患者）が高リスク群となっており、継続的な監視と公衆衛生介入が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт сообщил о выявлении нового рекомбинантного штамма оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert reports detection of a new recombinant strain of monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: New recombinant monkeypox virus detected, with Ib and IIb fragments. First identified in 2023 in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Ib drove the 2024 outbreak and spread beyond Africa. In late 2025–early 2026, cases in Britain and India involve this recombinant strain, described as a fundamentally new mechanism of monkeypox virus evolution. Experts warn of real-time evolution and the emergence of a new Ib clade that originated in 2023 DRC and caused 2024 epidemics, with two geographically/time-separated cases suggesting silent worldwide circulation. In Russia, doctors in St. Petersburg reported a new monkeypox case, patient hospitalized at Botkinskaya Infectious Diseases Hospital. Rospotrebnadzor urged protection by avoiding contact with animals, especially rodents and primates. In the Moscow region, following the new case, urgent checks and disinfection were conducted; the patient remains under medical observation.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が新しい組換えサル痘株の検出を報告
triage.triage_reason: 新型の組換えサル痘株（Ib/IIb）の検出は異常かつ予想外であり、複数国での確認、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、および国際的拡大リスクがIHR基準を満たす。既に英国、インド、ロシアで確認され、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC、インド、英国での確認が明記されているが、対象国リストに基づきDRCとインドのみを verified_locations に含める。ロシアでの症例報告も記載されているが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2023年DRC発生、2024年流行、2025-2026年の国際拡大という時系列が確認される。新型組換え株（Ib/IIb）の「根本的に新しい進化メカニズム」という記述は高い異常性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਸੈਂਟਰਲ ਜੇਲ੍ਹ 'ਚ ਨਵੇਂ ਕੈਦੀਆਂ ਦੀ 'ਨੋ ਐਂਟਰੀ', ਜੇਲ੍ਹਾਂ 'ਚ ਬਿਮਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਲਾਗ ਦਾ ਖ਼ਤਰਾ ਵਧਿਆ - No entry of new prisoners in Amritsar Central Jail risk of disease transmission in jails increased
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No entry of new inmates into Amritsar Central Jail; risk of disease transmission in jails has increased.
article.articleSummary: Amritsar Central Jail has halted entry of new inmates as overcrowding and unsafe conditions raise disease transmission risk. The facility reported 126 inmates co-infected with HIV and HBV, with outbreaks of Hepatitis A and E and jaundice-like illnesses tied to sanitation and crowding. Punjab State AIDS Control Society data show HIV cases rising from 4,131 in 2019-20 to 10,109 in 2022-23, highlighting strain on health systems. In 2024, the Punjab and Haryana High Court noted the crisis and sought a detailed state reply on jail overcrowding, healthcare facilities, medical staff shortages, emergency services, medical testing for new prisoners, and non-natural deaths in custody. The government stated 36 of 42 sanctioned medical officer posts and 35 of 48 pharmacist posts are filled, leaving vacancies; 42 non-natural death cases have been addressed by human rights commissions. Experts warn the situation will worsen without urgent reforms.

triage.headline_ja: アムリツァル中央刑務所への新規受刑者の入所禁止、刑務所における疾病伝播リスクが増加
triage.triage_reason: インドのアムリツァル刑務所で複数の血液由来感染症（HIV、肝炎A・B）とE肝炎が同時に発生しており、過密収容と不衛生な環境における集団感染リスクが高い。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が明確に該当し、州レベルの司法介入を伴う社会的関心も存在する。
triage.notes: 刑務所内の限定的な環境での集団感染であるが、HIV・肝炎A・肝炎Bの複数病原体の同時発生、州高裁による司法介入、医療職の欠員といった管理上の課題を示唆している。今後の拡大可能性とインド全国への健康システムへの負荷拡大に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 bird flu confirmed near Hesaraghatta
article.articleSummary: H5N1 bird flu confirmed in poultry at Mathikere village in Hesaraghatta, Bengaluru, Karnataka, with no human infections reported. Lab confirmation on April 14; rapid response teams visited on April 16. Infected zone radius 3 km around Mathikere; a 10 km surveillance zone. Under Animal Husbandry Department oversight, 7,444 birds, more than 14,000 eggs, and 2,250 kg of poultry feed were culled and disposed. Ten personnel involved in culling were quarantined and given medicine with regular medical monitoring. Public advised not to panic but remain vigilant. Health teams monitor 3,422 residents in two villages within the infected zone and 22,395 people in 17 villages under surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1鳥インフルエンザがヘサラガッタ付近で確認
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の動物感染が確認されており、ヒト感染はまだ報告されていません。IHR基準では異常性と国際拡大リスクが存在しますが、現段階では動物限定の感染で人的影響は限定的です。続報を注視する必要があります。
triage.notes: 現在のところヒト感染は報告されていないため重症度は低い評価。ただしH5N1は高い流行可能性を持つため、継続的な監視が必要です。動物での確認例は海外への輸出関連製品による拡大リスクはありますが、現報では特に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ngặn chặn chủng bệnh lở mồm long móng mới xâm nhập Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing a new strain of foot-and-mouth disease from entering Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces risk of introducing foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype SAT1, which is not yet present in the country. Vaccines available domestically protect serotypes O, A and Asia1, not SAT1; Quảng Ngãi province has received over 12,000 doses as preparedness. SAT1 circulates mainly in Africa’s Sahara region, with 13 topotypes; Iraq reported SAT1 in March 2025, followed by cases in other Middle East and West Asia countries. In early April 2026, China reported 219 SAT1 cases in Gansu (Cam Túc) and Xinjiang. The primary risk to Vietnam is illicit cross-border movement of livestock and animal products. Measures urged include enhanced surveillance and rapid typing of suspected LMLM cases, outbreak investigations and localized containment, stricter border controls on animal movements, and coordinated action among veterinary, police, border guards, market regulators, and local authorities. Plans include emergency vaccine imports, domestic SAT1 vaccine development, and comprehensive response preparedness."} }

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムへの新しい口蹄疫株の侵入を防止する
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1型という新しい病原体株がベトナムに侵入するリスクがあり、中国で既に219例が報告されている。これは異常・予想外であり、国境を越えた家畜の非合法取引による国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。IHR基準は4つ中3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではイラク（中東）にも言及されているが、イラク（ID:99237）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナムとは明記されており、中国（甘粛省新疆ウイグル自治区）での219例報告により両国が検証対象地域。ワクチン未対応のSAT1型という新型病原体の存在がリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo bệnh 'sốt đất' bùng phát tại Thái Lan làm nhiều người tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: the 'land fever' disease outbreak in Thailand has killed many people.
article.articleSummary: As of January 1 to mid-April 2026, Thailand reports 732 melioidosis cases and 23 deaths from Burkholderia pseudomallei, a soil- and water-dwelling bacterium. Referred to as 'land fever,' the outbreak is concentrated in Northeast Thailand, with Khon Kaen, Maha Sarakham, Roi Et, and Kalasin provinces recording the highest counts. Transmission occurs via skin wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust, or ingestion of contaminated water. Symptoms are variable but typically include sudden high fever, shortness of breath, chest pain, and swollen, slow-healing wounds; septicemia can develop, causing multi-organ failure and rapid death. High-risk groups include farmers and agricultural workers in direct mud or water contact, and people over 50 or with diabetes, kidney disease, thalassemia, or immune suppression. Prevention emphasizes gloves and rubber boots in the fields; seek care for fever lasting more than 2 days or unexplained fatigue or dyspnea. Early treatment improves outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：タイで『土地熱』病が大流行し、多くの人が死亡している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目が該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、地域拡大の可能性）。32例中23人の死亡率、732例の集中発生、および環境媒介での継続的な曝露リスクがあるため、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは土壌・水由来の環境病原体による感染症で、東北タイの農業地帯で継続的な曝露リスクが存在。高い致死率（23/732≒3.1%）と農業従事者への集中、50歳以上・基礎疾患者の易感染性が懸念要因。地理的集中（東北タイ4県）ながら、タイ全域での拡大可能性と周辺国への越境リスクを評価する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 国家生物信息中心合作发布面向流感病毒的基因组语言模型
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National Center for Bioinformation Jointly Releases a Genomic Language Model for Influenza Viruses
article.articleSummary: Influ-BERT, a Transformer-based genomic language model, was released by China's National Center for Bioinformation to advance influenza A virus research. Trained on ~900,000 influenza genome sequences, it uses a customized Byte Pair Encoding tokenizer and domain-adaptive pretraining with task-specific fine-tuning to deliver precise subtype identification and pathogenicity predictions, especially for low-frequency subtypes or fragmented data. The model also extends to other respiratory viruses, successfully distinguishing SARS-CoV-2, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus, and performing function-gene identification. Sliding-window perturbation analysis shows Influ-BERT self-focuses on biologically meaningful sites without manual labeling. Published as Influ-BERT: A Domain-Adaptive Genomic Language Model for Advancing Influenza A Virus Research in Briefings in Bioinformatics. Corresponding authors: Song Shuhui (National Center for Bioinformation) and Ana Tereza Ribeiro de Vasconcelos (LNCC, Brazil); first authors Ye Rongye and Li Lun. Funded by national R&D programs and Brazilian agencies.

triage.headline_ja: 国家生物情報センターが流感ウイルス向けゲノム言語モデルを共同発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は流感ウイルスの研究用AIモデル（Influ-BERT）の発表に関する学術的なニュースであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・エピデミックの報告ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急事象を示す疾患活動の増加、重症度の上昇、異常な発症動向などは記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はBluedot APIによって感染症イベント関連として抽出されたが、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、学術出版（Briefings in Bioinformatics掲載）された研究モデルの発表にすぎない。ゲノム研究ツール開発は予防医学面で有用だが、現在進行中の疾患動向や公衆衛生危機を示す情報は全く含まれていない。発生地域フィールドに中国とブラジルが列挙されているが、記事サマリーは研究成果の紹介に過ぎず、実際の感染症発生地を特定できないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: В связи с угрозой ящура в Узбекистане объявлен месяц санитарии и гигиены в животноводстве
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to the threat of rinderpest in Uzbekistan, a month of sanitation and hygiene in livestock farming has been declared.
article.articleSummary: Uzbekistan has declared a month-long sanitary-epidemiological hygiene drive in livestock farming from 18 April to 18 May due to a suspected rinderpest threat. No official confirmation of rinderpest in Uzbekistan is reported, but videos show cattle and calves with fever and oral/hoof lesions and deaths. The measure follows outbreaks in China and border-area vaccination efforts in Kazakhstan; Russia reportedly began mass cattle culling in late 2025 amid concerns. The World Organisation for Animal Health notes SAT serotype rinderpest circulating in 48 countries during 2025–2026, with current vaccines not fully protective. Recommended actions include strict veterinary-sanitary rules, disinfectant barriers at farm entrances, restricted access, good zoohygiene, quality feed and clean water, and ongoing cleanliness. Suspected cases require immediate isolation and veterinary consultation; do not self-medicate. Symptoms: high fever, oral ulcers, hoof/udder lesions. Vaccination for cattle twice yearly (spring and autumn); sheep annually; immunity 15–21 days post-vaccination. Hotline: 71-202-12-00 (internal 210, 218, 323).

triage.headline_ja: ウズベキスタンでのリンダーペスト脅威に関連して、家畜飼育における衛生と衛生管理の月間が宣言された
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（リンダーペスト）の国際的な流行兆候。中国、カザフスタン、ロシアでの流行との関連性があり、ウズベキスタンでも疑い症例が報告されており、国境を越えた拡大リスクが高い。動物衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではリンダーペストが中国、カザフスタン、ロシアで流行していると明記されており、ウズベキスタンでは疑い症例のみ報告されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはChina（1814991）のみ。本イベントは動物感染症であるが、国際的な公衆衛生・獣医学上の重大な懸念があり、SAT血清型が48カ国で循環中との情報あり。ワクチンの保護効果が完全でない点も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: How did 300 tons of diseased pork reach schools despite controls?
article.articleSummary: 300 tons of dirty pork infected with African Swine Fever circulated and were processed into meals, including for schoolchildren, in Lang Son province. A National Assembly field survey by the Committee on Science, Technology, and Environment, chaired by Nguyen Thanh Hai, inspected Lang Son’s border gates Huu Nghi, Tan Thanh, Chi Ma, and Coc Nam, plus schools, markets, and kitchens. The study found governance overlaps among Industry and Trade, Health, and Agriculture and Environment, with limited post-certification checks and scant testing of inputs at schools. Tan Thanh’s border gate operated a ‘green lane’ with unknown product quality; destruction of violative goods at Hai Phong was costly. Calls emerged for a dedicated food-safety agency or centralized authority, a risk-based facility classification, and higher penalties (VND 1–4 million) to deter violations. The 16th National Assembly will consider amendments to the Food Safety Law.

triage.headline_ja: 学校への流入を防ぐはずが、汚染された豚肉300トンはどのように到達したのか？
triage.triage_reason: African Swine Fever（アフリカ豚熱）の汚染豚肉が学校給食を含む食品加工に混入した重大な事案。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の大規模流通、国内管理体制の不備が明らかで、IHR基準およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Lang Son省の国境検査所から ASF 汚染豚肉が流入し、学校給食を含む食品加工に使用された重大事案。国家議会による調査で、複数省庁間の監督権の重複、事後確認の不足、入出国検査体制の不備が指摘されている。食品安全法の改正が第 16 期国家議会で検討予定。本事案は過去の農場流行レベルではなく、食品流通チェーン全体を巻き込む管理体制の崩壊を示唆する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Chủng mới lở mồm long móng lan rộng, nguy cơ xâm nhập Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New strain of foot-and-mouth disease spreading widely, risk of entry into Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype SAT1, a Picornaviridae virus, has spread from Africa to the Middle East and Western Asia, with China reporting 219 cattle cases in early April 2026 in Gansu and Xinjiang. Vietnam has not yet detected SAT1, but authorities warn the risk of entry is very high amid ongoing cross-border animal movement. Vaccines used in Vietnam cover only serotypes O, A, and Asia1; SAT1 is not protected. With a naive cattle population, infection could reach 100%; adult mortality is 1–5%, calves up to 20% or higher due to myocarditis and heart failure. Vietnam's 2016–2020 outbreaks included over 1,500 incidents in 56 provinces, more than 53,000 cattle infected, hundreds dead, and over 26,000 culled, with losses in trillions of dong. Measures: tighten border controls and movement, slaughter and trade controls, sanitation, surveillance at markets and abattoirs, diagnostic readiness, and potential import or domestic development of SAT1 vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の新しい株が広く蔓延、ベトナム侵入のリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。動物疾患だが経済的・食料安全保障への重大な影響があり、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。ベトナムと中国の両国で警戒態勢が高まっている。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫SAT1株はアフリカから中東・西アジアに拡大し、中国（甘粛省・新疆）で2026年4月に219頭の牛が感染。ベトナムは未検出だが侵入リスク高い。ベトナムのワクチンはO・A・Asia1のみでSAT1をカバーせず、感染時の牛群致死率は高く（仔牛20%以上）、過去のアウトブレイク実績から経済損失は甚大。動物疾患だが食料安全保障・輸出に大きな影響を与える重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe: Variante K e emergência em Goiás acendem alerta sanitário no DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu: Variant K and emergency in Goiás trigger a public health alert in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 April 2026, Goiás declared a state of emergency over Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome caused by influenza A(H3N2) variant K, triggering a public health alert in the Federal District (DF). DF surveillance confirms circulation of K, now predominant in South America in 2026, with 67 SRAG influenza cases and one death; no evidence yet of increased severity or reduced vaccine protection, but continuous monitoring is advised. Over 100,000 vaccine doses have been given across priority groups since March, but overall coverage remains far below the 90% target (Brazil-wide ~16.92%). In DF, elderly vaccination is 23%, pregnant 19.5%, and children 6 months–<6 years 10%. Other circulating respiratory viruses include RSV, rhinovirus, and metapneumovirus. Public health actions include accelerating vaccination campaigns, proactive primary care surveillance, and masking for symptomatic individuals to reduce transmission amid regional spread from Goiás.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ：ゴイアス州の変異株K と緊急事態が連邦地区の公衆衛生警報を発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、重篤性、国際拡大リスク）。ブラジルで新興インフルエンザH3N2変異株Kが確認され、複数州での流行と死亡報告、ワクチン接種率の低さが重大な懸念。
triage.notes: ブラジルのゴイアス州で緊急事態宣言。インフルエンザA(H3N2)変異株K（南米で優勢）による重篤急性呼吸器症候群SRAG 67例、死亡1例報告。連邦地区（DF）での警戒レベル上昇。ワクチン接種率が全国16.92%と極めて低く、重要な懸念。RSV、ライノウイルス、メタニューモウイルスも同時循環。

article.articleHeadline: Ancaman Penyakit Zoonosis Nyata Di Gianyar Bali, Pemkab Turun Tangan Di Sukawati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Real threat of zoonotic diseases in Gianyar, Bali; the regency government takes action in Sukawati.
article.articleSummary: Gianyar Regency, Bali, confronts real zoonotic risk, especially rabies, near Sukawati. On 19 April 2026—during Gianyar’s 255th anniversary and World Veterinary Day 2026—authorities held an integrated outreach in Banjar Gelumpang, Sukawati, Sukawati District, offering vaccination, sterilization, and animal health services. The program, a collaboration among UPTD Puskeswan III Dinas Pertanian Gianyar, professional associations, animal-lover groups, and community stakeholders, prioritizes vaccination as the primary rabies prevention, with sterilization to sustainably control stray animal populations, and on-site examinations, treatment, and education. Sekda Gianyar I Gusti Bagus Adi Widhya Utama (Gus Bem) warned that without consistent, wide-scale vaccination, transmission risk persists; prevention is wiser than treatment, and community participation is crucial for the health of animals, environment, and humans.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州ギアニャル県における人獣共通感染症の脅威が現実化、スカワティで地方政府が対応
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでの狂犬病リスク警告であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性・流行可能性）に該当する可能性があるが、現在のところ具体的な患者発生報告や重症事例が記事に記載されておらず、情報不足が顕著。政府による予防的介入の記事であり、進行中のアウトブレイク確認ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病リスクの警告と予防対策（ワクチン接種、避妊手術）に焦点を当てており、確認された患者発生例は記載されていない。ギアニャル県（バリ州）とバンテン州が地理的に列挙されているが、主要な記事内容はバリ州スカワティ地区に集中。人獣共通感染症リスクの継続的な曝露と流行可能性は認識されているが、重症度データと国際的拡大の証拠が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Agam lakukan imunisasi tambahan tekan penyebaran campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agam Regency Government carries out supplementary immunization to curb the spread of measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in Agam Regency, West Sumatra, prompted mass Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) across districts with outbreaks or low vaccination coverage, including Palembayan, Lubuk Basung, Sungai Pua, Ampek Angkek, Ampek Koto, Matur, Tanjung Raya and Kamang Magek. Health authorities also maintain routine measles immunization for nine-month-old infants at health centers and Posyandu, run awareness campaigns, and conduct early detection and rapid investigation of suspected cases. They trace transmission sources, identify vulnerable groups, and isolate and treat patients, providing supportive care such as vitamin A and antipyretics. A Rapid Response Team (Tim Gerak Cepat) was formed to respond quickly to outbreaks. From January 1 to April 18, 2026, 59 positive measles cases were reported in Agam, up from 48 cases in the previous year. Authorities hope the measures reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アガム県政府がはしかの拡散を抑えるための追加接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（西スマトラ州アガム県）でのはしか流行により、59件の確認患者が報告され、前年同期比で増加傾向。公衆衛生への影響が深刻であり、複数地区での発症確認とワクチン接種率低下地域での集団接種対応実施から、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行容易性、管理対応）に複数該当し、シグナルとして認識。
triage.notes: 記事は西スマトラ州アガム県でのはしか流行の対応策（ORI実施、ラピッドレスポンスチーム設置）を記述。2026年1月1日～4月18日で59例の確定患者が報告され、前年同期の48例から増加。複数地区での感染確認と予防接種率低下地域での対応から、地域内での流行が進行中と判断される。国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクについては記事に情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan báo động về dịch sốt đất 2026: 732 Ca nhiễm và 23 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand on alert over the 2026 land fever outbreak: 732 infections and 23 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports a major Melioidosis (earth fever) outbreak with 732 infections and 23 deaths since Jan 1, 2026, as of Apr 18, 2026, with pronounced impact in the northeast, especially Khon Kaen where 68 cases and 2 deaths have been recorded in the regional authority. The Public Health Ministry says it is ongoing monitoring. Burkholderia pseudomallei resides in soil and standing water; transmission occurs through skin wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust, or use of untreated water. Highest risk among people over 50, and those with diabetes or kidney disease. Clinical presentation ranges from high fever and respiratory failure to chronic abscesses and skin infections; bacteremia can occur in severe cases, posing life-threatening risk. Early detection allows effective treatment. Protective measures for at-risk groups include boots and gloves; seek medical care promptly for high fever or symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タイが2026年土壌熱（メリオイドーシス）流行について警報：732人の感染と23人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。732感染、23死亡の大規模流行で重症度が高く、Northeast地域での継続的な曝露リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは環境中の土壌・水中に存在するBurkholderia pseudomalleiによる感染症。Northeast地域（特にKhon Kaen県）での集中流行。糖尿病・腎臓病・50歳以上の高リスク群への影響が大きい。土壌・水への環境曝露が継続的に存在するため、単発イベントではなく季節的または長期的な流行リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam chủ động ngăn chặn, phòng chống khi dịch lở mồm long móng SAT1 lan rộng toàn cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam Takes Proactive Measures to Prevent and Control SAT1 Foot-and-Mouth Disease as It Spreads Worldwide.
article.articleSummary: SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease virus, a Picornaviridae/aphthovirus, is spreading globally with 13 SAT1 topotypes (I–XIII) and commonly affects sheep, goats, and other ruminants. By April 2026, China reported 219 SAT1 cases in cattle in Gansu and Xinjiang (first in those provinces); earlier, SAT1 appeared in Iraq (March 2025) and subsequently in the Middle East and West Asia, including Bahrain, Iran, Israel, Kuwait, Lebanon, Egypt, Cyprus, Turkey, and Azerbaijan. Vietnam has not recorded SAT1, but the risk of introduction is high, especially via illicit cross-border movement of animals. Vietnamese vaccines currently protect only serotypes O, A, and Asia1, with no protection against SAT1. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development calls for strengthened border-to-farm surveillance, crackdown on illegal animal transport, biosecurity training for farmers, contingency planning, accelerated vaccine research/import, wildlife surveillance, and inter-agency coordination to prevent and respond to SAT1 incursions.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、世界中に広がっているSAT1口蹄疫に対して積極的に防止・制御措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（SAT1型）は中国、イラク、中東、西アジア、ベトナムなど多数の国で確認・警戒されており、IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスク・経済的影響が明確。WPRO基準でも異常性・流行性・管理可能性が該当し、シグナルとして認識される。
triage.notes: 記事は中国（甘粛省・新疆ウイグル自治区）でのSAT1口蹄疫219例報告とベトナムの防止対策を主題としている。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはクウェート、イラク、イランなど中東・西アジア諸国も含まれるが、サマリー上で確定的な発生報告はベトナムの警戒フェーズおよび中国の報告に限定される。対象国リストに含まれるのはChina(1814991)とVietnam(1562822)のみ。家畜感染症であるが経済的影響・国際貿易への影響が大きく、農業部門の対応が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Fever for 3 days? Don't ignore it: How to spot malaria symptoms early and avoid serious complications
article.articleSummary: Malaria risk in India during summer and monsoon is highlighted when fever patterns mimic viral illness but mask a serious infection. The NCVBDC notes malaria symptoms can start mild yet worsen without timely treatment. Key clinical cues include fever with chills and sweating, fatigue disproportionate to illness, headaches, and a fever persisting beyond two to three days, which warrants testing. Simple blood tests can detect malaria early, enabling prompt treatment and preventing complications. Dr. Sandeep Reddy Koppula emphasizes not treating every fever as viral and warns that delays can be dangerous. Prevention focuses on avoiding stagnant water, using mosquito repellents, and maintaining cleanliness. The article urges attention to fever behavior—duration, recurrence, and associated symptoms—rather than just temperature, to distinguish malaria from dengue or typhoid during summer and monsoon in India.

triage.headline_ja: 3日間の発熱？無視しないで：マラリアの症状を早期に見つけ、深刻な合併症を避ける方法
triage.triage_reason: インドでのマラリア、デング熱、チフスのリスク啓発記事。IHR基準は2つ以上該当する見込みが低く、スクリーニング基準では異常性および長期曝露の可能性がYesだが、具体的な流行規模、死亡例、国家的危機管理の必要性が明記されていない情報不足状態。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発および症状認識の重要性を強調する教育的内容であり、具体的な流行発生の報告ではない。インド国家ベクター媒介疾患制御センター（NCVBDC）の知見に基づくが、新規アウトブレイク、異常な増加、または緊急対応の必要性を示す情報は含まれていない。夏季および雨季のマラリアリスクは地域内で周期的・予想可能なものとして記述されている。

article.articleHeadline: В Узбекистане ввели режим повышенной санитарной готовности из-за угрозы ящура
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uzbekistan, a state of heightened sanitary readiness has been introduced due to the threat of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Uzbekistan declares a month-long sanitary-epidemiological hygiene in livestock from 18 April to 18 May to prevent foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) spread amid regional alerts. No official Uzbek outbreaks yet, but social-media videos show cattle with FMD symptoms. A new SAT (South African Territories) serotype, reported in 48 countries during 2025–2026, reduces vaccine efficacy; existing vaccines offer incomplete protection. Measures include disinfectant barriers at farm entrances, strict access limits, isolation of suspicious animals, and urgent veterinary contact (71-202-12-00); milk must be boiled; exporting livestock products from quarantine zones is banned. China reported SAT1 outbreaks in April in Gansu and Xinjiang, likely via northwest borders; Russia has culled over 90,000 cattle in 10 regions since late 2025. Kazakhstan halted meat and feed imports from Russia and started border vaccination. In Uzbekistan, cattle immunity develops 15–21 days after vaccination; cattle require twice-yearly vaccination, sheep annually; farm biosecurity and rapid isolation are critical.

triage.headline_ja: ウズベキスタンが口蹄疫の脅威により衛生警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。地域の多国間における動物疾病の急速な拡大、新型血清型の出現、複数国での対応措置が確認されており、シグナルとして識別が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは中国（甘粛省・新疆ウイグル自治区）でのSAT1型口蹄疫の公式発生報告（2026年4月）が確認されている。ウズベキスタンは公式な発生報告なく、アラート段階。ロシア・カザフスタンも関連地域として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。新型血清型（SAT）の報告、複数国でのワクチン効果低下、広域にわたる家畜の大量淘汰（ロシアで90,000頭以上）、国境措置・輸出禁止など、多国間の影響と対応が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo virus lở mồm long móng 'lạ' có nguy cơ xâm nhập Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Novel foot-and-mouth disease virus poses a risk of entering Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Novel foot-and-mouth disease virus SAT1 poses a high risk of entering Vietnam. The SAT1 serotype has never been detected in the country, and existing vaccines offer no protection. SAT1 is spreading from Africa to the Middle East and West Asia and has been detected in China. The Ministry of Agriculture warns that illegal import, transport, and sale of animals and animal products at the border could trigger an outbreak with severe losses to the livestock sector, including buffalo, cattle, pigs, goats, and sheep. Authorities call for tightened border controls, strict anti-smuggling enforcement, and ready-to-use diagnostic centers with reagents and procedures to detect SAT1 early. Surveillance will target border posts, farms, slaughterhouses, and markets; interagency coordination will guide a comprehensive response plan. The ministry also seeks urgent import of suitable vaccines, fast-track emergency procedures, and long-term efforts to develop and produce SAT1 vaccines domestically for self-reliance.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：新型口蹄疫ウイルスがベトナムに侵入するリスク
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1血清型は新興病原体であり、ベトナムでは未検出。アフリカから中国を経由して西アジアへ拡大中で、国際的な家畜衛生上の重大な脅威となる。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさが該当し、ベトナム政府が強い警戒と対策を表明している。
triage.notes: SAT1血清型は過去にベトナムで検出されておらず、既存ワクチンは無効。アフリカから中東・西アジアを経由して中国で検出された後、ベトナム侵入のリスクが高まっている。国境での違法な動物・動物製品の取引が主要な侵入経路として指摘されている。畜牛、水牛、豚、羊、ヤギなど重要な畜産業に対する深刻な脅威。ベトナム農業省が緊急対応体制と国際支援の必要性を表明しており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chủng lở mồm long móng mới xuất hiện ở Trung Quốc, nguy cơ xâm nhập vào Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New foot-and-mouth disease strain has emerged in China, posing a risk of spreading to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 April 2026, Vietnam faces potential entry of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) serotype SAT1 as the virus spreads from the Middle East to China. SAT1, mainly circulating in Africa’s Sahara subregion with 13 topotypes (SAT1/I–SAT1/XIII), typically affects sheep, goats, and wild water buffalo. FAO reports SAT1 emerged in Iraq in March 2025 and has since appeared across the Middle East and West Asia; in early April 2026 China reported 219 cattle infections of SAT1 topotype I in Gansu and Xinjiang. Vietnam has not recorded SAT1, but vaccines licensed locally protect only serotypes O, A, and Asia1, not SAT1. The Ministry urges strict controls on animal transport and cross-border trade, crackdown on smuggling, and rapid contingency planning, including emergency vaccine procurement, domestic SAT1 vaccine development, and enhanced diagnostics and surveillance. The Prime Minister is asked to coordinate inter-ministerial action and empower border provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で新型口蹄疫株が出現、ベトナムへの侵入リスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。動物感染症だが家畜経済への重大な影響、中東→中国→ベトナムへの国際的な拡大リスク、ワクチン未対応株の出現が確認される。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫SAT1型は中東（イラク、2025年3月）から中国（2026年4月）に広がり、ベトナムへの侵入リスクが高まっている。ベトナムの現有ワクチンはO、A、Asia1型のみで、SAT1型に対応していない。中国での犬感染数は219頭（甘粛、新疆）。ワクチン未対応の新型株の出現と国際的な拡大経路が確認されており、緊急対応が必要。
