article.articleHeadline: 紧急提醒：近期波动上升！广东报告1起流感暴发疫情，有深圳网友称家里俩娃全中招_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent reminder: Recent fluctuations on the rise! Guangdong reports one influenza outbreak; a Shenzhen netizen says both children at home were infected.
article.articleSummary: On Week 15, 2026 (Apr 6–12), Guangdong’s influenza-like illness (ILI) sentinel at emergency departments shows ILI at 5.28% of visits (up from 4.69%, below baseline 5.89%). Influenza positivity among ILI specimens is 9.94% (up from 8.94%, below baseline 12.44%), with B(Victoria) lineage 87.85%, A(H3N2) 11.22%, A(H1N1)pdm09 0.93%. In multi-pathogen ARTI surveillance, outpatients’ ILI samples test positive for influenza (11.92%), parainfluenza (6.92%), rhinovirus (6.54%); hospitalized SARI samples positive for rhinovirus (5.38%), with RSV, parainfluenza, common coronavirus, bocavirus, enterovirus, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae each at 2.31%. One ILI outbreak was reported and controlled. Guangdong CDC expert Kang Min notes activity rising out of season, mainly B(Victoria); other viruses show activity. A Shenzhen netizen reported both children at home infected. March 2026 overview: 117,924 infectious disease cases in Guangdong; Class C top: influenza, HFMD, other infectious diarrhea.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急注意喚起：最近の変動が上昇中！広東省がインフルエンザ集団発生1件を報告、深圳のネットユーザーが家の子ども2人が感染したと述べる
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザ、RSV、マイコプラズマなど）の多病原体活動が検出されており、B(Victoria)系統の流行が季節外の上昇を示していることから、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ）に該当する。ただし現段階では単一の局所的集団発生であり、国際的拡大リスクや重大な公衆衛生への影響の明確な証拠に乏しいため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: 記事は広東省（深圳を含む）における多病原体呼吸器感染症の活動状況を報告している。B(Victoria)インフルエンザ系統の季節外の上昇、RSV・マイコプラズマなどの同時流行、および1件の局所的集団発生が報告されている。個別事例（深圳の網友の子ども2人感染）は市民の関心を示しているが、現段階では重症度や国際的拡大リスクの具体的な証拠は示されていない。引き続き広東省CDCの監視情報および多病原体パタールの変化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động kiểm soát, ngăn ngừa dịch lở mồm long móng xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactively control and prevent foot-and-mouth disease from entering
article.articleSummary: SAT1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) threatens Vietnam amid the spread. SAT1 has reached the Middle East and Western Asia, with Iraq, Iran, Israel, and Türkiye affected; China reported 219 FMD cases in Gansu and Xinjiang. Vietnam has not detected SAT1 but faces a high risk of introduction via cross-border livestock movements and informal trade. In-country vaccines protect only against serotypes O, A, and Asia1; SAT1 is not covered. The Ministry of Agriculture and Environment has ordered urgent measures: bolster surveillance and laboratory confirmation at border farms; tighten controls on movement, transport, and trade of livestock at borders, markets, slaughterhouses, ports, and airports; public messaging against unknown-origin livestock. Plans include expanding testing capacity, nationwide surveillance, contingency planning, vaccine import, and domestic SAT1 vaccine development; funding and stockpiling will be arranged by the Ministry of Finance. Quang Ngai Province allocated over 12,900 vaccine doses to localities.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の侵入を主動的に管理・予防する
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1血清型が中東・西アジアで拡大し、中国でも確認されている状況で、ベトナムは高いリスクに直面している。異常性・予想外性が高く、地域的な拡大リスクと管理可能性の懸念があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たす。
triage.notes: SAT1血清型の口蹄疫は既に中東（イラク、イラン、イスラエル、トルコ）で確認されており、中国（甘粛省・新疆ウイグル自治区）での219例の発生が報告されている。ベトナムは現在SAT1を検出していないが、越境家畜移動と非公式な取引を通じた導入リスクが極めて高い。国内ワクチンはSAT1をカバーしておらず、緊急対応が必要な状況。ベトナム農業・環境省が国境での監視強化、家畜移動制限等の緊急措置を命じている。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkab Agam lakukan imunisasi tekan penyebaran campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agam Regency Government conducts measles immunization to curb the spread of measles.
article.articleSummary: Agam Regency, West Sumatra, launched mass Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) against measles in districts with outbreaks or low immunization coverage, including Palembayan, Lubuk Basung, Sungai Pua, Ampek Angkek, Ampek Koto, Matur, Tanjung Raya, and Kamang Magek. In addition to ORI, routine measles vaccination for nine‑month‑old infants at puskesmas and posyandu, and a campaign to educate communities on measles symptoms, transmission, and vaccination importance were conducted. The health office emphasizes early detection, rapid reporting and investigation of suspected cases, tracing transmission sources, and identifying vulnerable groups during outbreaks. Isolation and supportive care (vitamin A and antipyretics) are provided to patients, with a fast‑response team activated. From January through April 18, 2026, 59 positive measles cases were reported, up from 48 in the prior year; authorities aim to reduce cases further.

triage.headline_ja: アガム県政府、麻疹蔓延の抑制を目的とした予防接種を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（西スマトラ州アガム県）での麻疹発生を確認。2026年1月～4月中旬で59例の報告があり、前年同期48例から増加。しかし記事は当局の対応措置（予防接種キャンペーン）に焦点があり、国際的拡大リスク・深刻な死亡例の記載はなく、現在の情報では IHR 基準2つ以上の確実な該当は難しい。スクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」には該当の可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月19日配信で、西スマトラ州アガム県における麻疹の集団発生対応が主題。当局による積極的な対応（予防接種キャンペーン、検出・報告体制強化）が実施されており、管理可能性は現在のところ良好と判断される。死亡例やより広範な国際的リスクについては記載がなく、判定には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: หมอเจด พารู้จัก โรคเมลิออยด์โดสิส ติดง่าย ลามไว อันตรายถึงตาย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Jed Introduces Melioidosis: Easy to Contract, Spreads Rapidly, Deadly
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis in Thailand is highlighted by 732 reported cases and 23 deaths as of 2026-04-19. The disease is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, a bacterium thriving in soil and water. Transmission occurs via wounds, inhalation of dust or droplets, or ingestion of contaminated water. Early symptoms resemble flu—fever, aches, fatigue—but can rapidly progress to septicemia affecting the lungs, liver, and spleen, with possible shock. High-risk groups include diabetics, chronic kidney or liver disease, immunosuppressed individuals, and agricultural workers who expose themselves to soil or standing water. Prevention is simple but requires discipline: wear boots and gloves in muddy environments, keep wounds clean and rinse promptly, drink clean water, and seek prompt medical care if fever persists. Early diagnosis and treatment improve survival; delays can be fatal. Emphasis on rural Thailand and mud-prone settings.

triage.headline_ja: 医者ジェドがメリオイドーシスを紹介：感染しやすく、急速に拡がり、致命的
triage.triage_reason: タイで報告されたメリオイドーシスの732例、23死亡例はIHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「重症度の高さ」に該当。スクリーニング基準では重症度・流行リスク・長期曝露の複数項目に該当し、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と農業従事者など多くの人口への継続的曝露が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はメディア報道（医療専門家による公開情報提供）であり、732例・23死亡という具体的数字が提示されている。土壌・水環境での継続的なリスク、農業従事者と糖尿病患者など特定集団への高いリスク、初期症状が流感様で診断遅延のリスクがある。ドロップレット/吸入・創傷感染による人-人感染の可能性も記載されているため、流行リスクは中程度以上と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccination in UP drive to provide protection against Diphtheria and Tetanus
article.articleSummary: UP, led by Lucknow-based officials, launches a statewide school-based TD/DPT vaccination campaign to protect children against Diphtheria and Tetanus. The drive will run in government and government-aided schools on April 20, 21, 23, 24, 27 and 28, during the seasonal period favorable to diphtheria spread. Eligible students receive: Class 1 – DPT-2 booster; Classes 4–5 – TD-10; Classes 10–11 – TD-16 booster. A nodal teacher in every school and ANMs will compile school lists, formulate action plans, and report daily progress. Unvaccinated children can still receive TD-10 or TD-16. Post-vaccination observation lasts about 30 minutes; mild fever may occur and is managed. Officials emphasize timely, accessible vaccination to strengthen immunity and prevent infection, aiming to ensure no child is left unvaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州でジフテリアと破傷風に対する予防接種キャンペーン実施
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリアと破傷風に対する予防接種キャンペーンであり、疾患の発生・流行を報告するものではなく、公衆衛生上の計画的な予防活動である。異常な発生、重症例、死亡など感染症危機を示す情報がなく、IHR基準やWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベント（異常発生・流行）ではなく、政府主導の予防接種キャンペーン報道である。疾患の発生状況や症例情報を含まず、定期的な公衆衛生対策であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Estado de SP registra primeiros casos de febre amarela do ano; vacinação é fundamental - Jornal Cidade RC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State of São Paulo records first cases of yellow fever for the year; vaccination is essential.
article.articleSummary: Three yellow fever cases confirmed in the Vale do Paraíba region, São Paulo, Brazil. In Cruzeiro, a 23-year-old woman and a 52-year-old man recovered; in Cunha, a 38-year-old man died. All three had no vaccination history. The CVE-SP reported these cases on Thursday (16). The SES-SP emphasizes vaccination as the principal prevention and control measure; vaccination has been recommended statewide since 2019. Travelers to risk areas should be vaccinated at least 10 days before travel. Authorities urge people to verify vaccination status before visiting forests, rural areas, zones with viral circulation, or ecotourism sites, and to report suspected human cases and non-human primate epizootics immediately to health services to enable timely response. Vaccination is free; routine schedule for children is 9 months with a 4-year booster; a single dose is recommended for those aged 5+ without vaccination records.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州が今年最初の黄熱病症例を記録；ワクチン接種が必須
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州でこの年最初の黄熱病症例が確認され、死亡者を含む3例が報告された。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、シグナル識別基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州パライバ渓谷地域での黄熱病事例を報告。2026年のブラジル国内最初の症例であり、死亡者を含む。公開情報なし（記事本文欠損）だが、サマリーから十分なリスク情報あり。WPRO基準では異常性・重症度・ベクター媒介感染の継続曝露・流行可能性が確認され、予防可能な感染症での死亡例として公衆衛生への影響は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo virus lở mồm long móng chủng mới có thể vào Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: A new strain of foot-and-mouth disease virus could enter Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of April 19, 2026, Vietnam faces the risk that foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) virus SAT1 serotype could enter the country. SAT1 is not currently detected in Vietnam; vaccines in use cover types O, A, and Asia1 only, leaving SAT1 unprotected. Globally, SAT1 has circulated mainly in Africa and recently spread to the Middle East and West Asia; in early April 2026 China reported over 200 SAT1 cases in Gansu and Xinjiang, raising cross-border introduction risk via livestock movement and smuggling. Vietnamese livestock—buffalo, cattle, pigs, goats, sheep, deer, and related species—have little immunity to SAT1, with infection potentially reaching 100%; adult mortality ~1–5%, but 20% or higher in neonates and young stock due to myocarditis and heart failure. If introduced, the outbreak could severely disrupt the sector and cause major economic losses. The Ministry urges enhanced surveillance, strict control of animal transport, border interdiction, farmer biosecurity, inter-agency coordination, and contingency vaccine planning.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：新型口蹄疫ウイルス株がベトナムに侵入する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1株は中国で確認され、ベトナムへの越境侵入リスクが明らかで、ベトナム家畜の感染率は100%に達する可能性があり、経済損失が大きい。IHR基準で重大な公衆衛生影響（動物衛生）と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 中国（甘粛・新疆）でSAT1型FMD（200例以上）が報告され、ベトナムへの越境リスクが高い。ベトナムのワクチンはO、A、Asia1型のみで、SAT1に対する免疫がない。ベトナム政府は監視強化と国境管理を要請している。動物疾病ながら経済的・社会的影響が大きく、地域的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Blood bank ex-staffer arrested 6 months after children get HIV 'following blood transfusion'
article.articleSummary: Nine thalassemia-affected minors in Chaibasa, Jharkhand, were infected with HIV after transfusions from the Chaibasa Sadar Hospital blood bank beginning October 2025; initial five cases, later four more positives confirmed. Following Jharkhand High Court's February 4 directive, an FIR was registered against Manoj Prasad, a former Chaibasa Sadar Hospital blood bank staffer, and he was arrested about two months later. Police seized donor registers from the blood bank for court submission as the investigation continues to probe other staff involvement and potential systemic lapses, including alleged tampering with donor records. Families of victims report social and economic hardship, including eviction threats and schooling disruption, as they await accountability and a full investigation outcome.

triage.headline_ja: 血液銀行元職員が逮捕 血液輸血後にHIV感染した子どもたちから6ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（9名の未成年がHIV感染）と異常性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と管理可能性の懸念が高い。血液安全に関わる重大なシステムラプスが示唆されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 血液銀行における感染性血液の使用・ドナー記録の改ざん疑い等、医療関連感染制御の重大な脆弱性が明らかになった事案。被害者家族の社会的・経済的困窮も報告されている。Jharkhand州保健当局の対応能力評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ dịch lở mồm long móng chủng mới xâm nhập vào Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of a New Strain of Foot-and-Mouth Disease Entering Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) serotype SAT1 poses a risk of entering Vietnam, where serotypes O, A, and Asia1 have circulated since 2020, predominantly via O/ME-SA/Ind2001e. SAT1 has not been detected domestically, but its rapid spread elsewhere raises concerns about illegal cross-border movement of cattle and animal products. Vaccines licensed in Vietnam currently protect only serotypes O, A, and Asia1, not SAT1. If SAT1 breaches Vietnam, the cattle sector could suffer substantial economic losses without timely prevention and response. The Ministry of Agriculture and Environment has directed local authorities to boost surveillance, rapidly test suspected cases at farms and border areas, and conduct investigations to keep outbreaks limited. They urged tighter border controls, crackdown on illicit livestock trade, and public biosecurity campaigns near borders. A plan to authorize contingency measures and import SAT1-appropriate vaccines is being considered.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムに侵入するリスクがある口蹄疫の新しい株
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の新規血清型（SAT1）がベトナムへの侵入リスクを持ち、国内流行していない株であり、異常かつ予想外なイベント。農業省が積極的な監視と国境管理を強化しており、動物疾患としての国際的拡大可能性とワクチン対応の管理性が課題となるため、スクリーニング基準複数該当且つ政府関心が高い。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は動物疾患だがWHO/FAO共同関心事項であり、ベトナムの農業経済に重大な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。SAT1は国内で未検出だが、新規侵入リスクとしての異常性が高く、違法な家畜越境移動を含む対策が必要。ワクチン対応の制限も管理上の課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: बिहार का यह जिला बन रहा HIV संक्रमण का हॉटस्पॉट, जनवरी से अब तक 21 मरीज संक्रमित - sheikhpura hiv hotspot with rising cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sheikhpura district in Bihar is becoming a hotspot for HIV infections, 21 patients infected so far since January.
article.articleSummary: Sheikhpura district in Bihar is emerging as an HIV hotspot, with 21 new infections identified from January through April 18, 2026. March alone saw 10 new cases. The district, covering 682 square kilometers with an estimated population near 900,000, already had about 500 people on free treatment under the National AIDS Control Programme. Most testing is done through government channels; however, many pregnant women and their husbands avoid testing, undermining prevention. Government policy mandates free HIV testing for all pregnant women and their spouses, but uptake remains low; husbands frequently skip testing. Transmission is primarily through unsafe sexual activity, including cases where men who have sexual relations abroad transmit infection to wives. One pregnant woman diagnosed is receiving specialized care and antiretroviral therapy. The article highlights the need for intensified surveillance to prevent Sheikhpura from becoming a HIV hotspot.

triage.headline_ja: ビハール州シェイクプラ地区がHIV感染のホットスポットに、1月以降21人が感染
triage.triage_reason: インドの特定地域におけるHIV新規感染の増加が報告されているが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当および社会的関心の確たる証拠が不足。引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: シェイクプラ地区での4ヶ月間のHIV新規感染者21名は地域的には増加傾向を示しているが、全国的または国際的な懸念の水準には至らない。妊婦および配偶者の検査回避、海外での感染後の女性配偶者への伝播など、根本的なリスク要因が存在。国内当局による監視と対策強化が進行中であることが記事から読み取れるが、外部支援の必要性は不明。情報が限定的であるため、さらなる疫学情報の集約が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sàng lọc cộng đồng tại Nghệ An phát hiện 171 ca nghi mắc bệnh lao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Community screening in Nghe An detects 171 suspected tuberculosis cases.
article.articleSummary: TB screening at community level in Nghe An, Vietnam, detected 171 suspected TB cases in one week (10–17 April) as Nghệ An Lung Hospital partnered with Nghĩa Đàn Health Center across 23 screening posts in Nghĩa Đàn and nearby communes. Over 5,300 residents, especially high-risk groups such as those with prior TB, close contacts, prolonged respiratory symptoms, or chronic diseases, were screened using mobile digital chest X-ray with AI to flag abnormalities. Of 463 abnormal X-ray findings, 10 were confirmed TB by GeneXpert testing, including one drug-resistant TB case; all patients were enrolled for management and treatment. The program aims to cut transmission through early detection. Dr. Nguyen Thanh Hai, Director of Nghệ An Lung Hospital, says the unit will expand this approach with more advanced technology. Since 2026, periodic health examinations will include TB screening to support early detection and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省でのコミュニティスクリーニングで結核の疑い患者171人を検出
triage.triage_reason: 結核の早期検出プログラムとして疾患検出数は相応であるが、国内スクリーニング事業という文脈で国際的拡大リスクは低い。国内の公衆衛生対応として位置づけられるため、情報の追加進展を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性疾患であり、ベトナムの継続的な公衆衛生対応として位置づけられている。171名の疑い患者は確定診断ベースでは10名であり、確定ケース数は限定的。ただし結核は長期曝露の対象であり、流行しやすい感染症である点から WPRO基準2つを満たす。しかし国内スクリーニング事業としての性格が強く、国際的拡大リスクは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: CG News: जंगली बिल्ली के काटने से महिला की मौत, झोलाछाप डॉक्टर के इलाज और झाड़फूक में फंसे रहे परिजन, एंटी-रेबिज लेने से पहले ही फैल चुका था वायरस - Lalluram
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chhattisgarh News: Woman dies after a wild cat bite; relatives trapped in a quack doctor's treatment and in exorcism; the virus had already spread before taking the anti-rabies vaccine - Lalluram
article.articleSummary: 65-year-old Matin Kunwar, a resident of Pangwan village in the Jalkhe Panchayat, Gaurela-Pendra-Marwahi, Chhattisgarh, died from rabies after a wild cat bite. The attack occurred 20–25 days earlier in nearby forest, with the left leg severely injured. Family delayed proper medical care, instead taking her to a quack doctor and undergoing exorcism, resulting in a critical treatment delay. Weather changes (lightning and rain) coincided with worsening condition. Physicians observed clear rabies symptoms (hydrophobia/photophobia). The first dose of anti-rabies vaccine was administered on 15 April at the district hospital, but by then the virus had already spread throughout the body, and she died during treatment. District hospital doctors preliminarily confirmed active rabies as the cause; post-mortem findings are pending. The report notes that delay and alleged negligence in seeking medical care contributed to the outcome.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティスガル州ニュース：野生猫に咬まれた女性が死亡、家族が民間医療と祈祷にはまり、抗狂犬病ワクチン投与前にウイルスが既に体全体に広がっていた
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡事例であり、IHR基準の異常性・予想外性に該当するが、単一症例の報告であり国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への広範な影響は現時点では不明。社会的関心（医療アクセスの問題）はあるが、情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 単一の致死的狂犬病事例。記事はチャッティスガル州での野生猫咬傷に由来する発症であり、医療アクセスの遅延と民間医療への依存が死亡転帰に寄与した社会的課題を強調しているため公開の関心は存在。しかしヒト-ヒト感染性なし、集団発生の兆候なし。IHR基準は2つ以上満たすが、スクリーニング基準での流行可能性（epidemic_prone）は低く、単一症例報告であることから、WATCHスタンスでの継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ứng phó nguy cơ vi rút lở mồm long móng xâm nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Responding to the risk of foot-and-mouth disease virus incursion.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development issued Directive 3781/BNNMT-CNTY on 17 April to proactively prevent the incursion of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) virus serotype SAT1 into Vietnam. FMD, caused by Aphthovirus in the Picornaviridae family, affects cloven-hoofed species with high morbidity and relatively low adult mortality (1–5%; higher in calves, lambs, and fawns). SAT1 circulates mainly in Africa’s Sahara subregion (13 topotypes) and typically infects sheep, goats, and wild buffalo; it has not been detected in Vietnam. The rapid potential spread of SAT1 poses a major threat to the domestic cattle industry if introduced. Measures emphasize surveillance, movement controls, anti-smuggling, awareness, risk assessment, and contingency planning; vaccines in Vietnam cover serotypes O, A, Asia1 only. The plan calls for inter-ministerial coordination, provincial sampling/testing, SAT1 diagnostics, emergency vaccine imports, domestic vaccine development, and wildlife monitoring near forests and protected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫ウイルス侵入リスクへの対応
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1型がアフリカで流行し、ベトナムへの侵入リスクが指摘されている。ベトナムは予防的措置を講じている段階だが、実際の発症例報告はなく、また家畜感染症であるため人命への直接的リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事は潜在的リスク対応の指示であり、ベトナムでの実際の発症例報告ではない。SAT1型は主にアフリカに限定されており、ベトナムへの侵入は未確認。影響カテゴリが『animals』に限定され、人獣共通感染症としてのヒト健康への直接的脅威は記載されていない。継続的な監視が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Phụ nữ 35 tuổi tử vong sau khi ăn đồ thừa trong tủ lạnh , cảnh báo Listeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 35-year-old woman dies after eating leftovers in the fridge; Listeria warning.
article.articleSummary: In Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China, a 35-year-old pregnant woman developed listeriosis after eating leftovers stored in a home fridge and died two days after her 35th birthday, with the fetus in utero. She was hospitalized for about three months despite aggressive treatment. Listeria monocytogenes is a widespread, cold-tolerant bacterium found in soil, water, and on produce; it can grow at refrigeration temperatures, so common fridges do not fully prevent it. During pregnancy, immune changes raise risk about tenfold, and the bacterium can cross the placenta, causing uterine infection, miscarriage, premature birth, or stillbirth, and neonatal sepsis or meningitis if the infant survives. Early symptoms are nonspecific (fever, muscle aches, diarrhea), delaying treatment. Preventive advice includes separating raw and cooked foods, reheating leftovers to at least 70°C for 10 minutes, avoiding storage beyond two days, and washing produce. Pregnant women should avoid pre-made salads, sushi, and refrigerated deli meats, and maintain clean kitchen practices.

triage.headline_ja: 35歳女性が冷蔵庫の残り物を食べた後に死亡；リステリア警告
triage.triage_reason: 妊娠中の女性による死亡事例、胎児死亡を伴う重度の臨床転帰、リステリア菌の冷蔵保管での増殖能による家庭衛生リスク、妊娠女性への特有の脆弱性に関する公衆衛生警告として、IHR基準（異常性、重症度）とWPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露リスク、管理可能性）に該当。
triage.notes: 記事は河南省鄭州市での妊娠女性によるリステリア症の死亡事例を報告。冷蔵庫での残り物保管に関連した感染リスク、妊娠期の免疫低下による感染易感染性、胎児・新生児への垂直感染リスクが強調されている。公衆衛生的メッセージを含む。

article.articleHeadline: Cum ar putea provoca teroriștii milioane de victime folosind viruși modificați și de ce o nouă pandemie ar putea fi aproape
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How terrorists could cause millions of victims using modified viruses and why a new pandemic could be imminent.
article.articleSummary: Global biosecurity experts warn that large-scale bioterrorism and pandemics could be triggered with limited resources, even by a single laboratory. Two main scenarios: theft of materials from specialized labs or using infected individuals as vectors, potentially triggering global disruption. The threat of 'Disease X' - a virus far deadlier than Covid-19 - and the risk of accidental lab leaks from high-security facilities handling Ebola, Nipah, and other hemorrhagic agents loom amid uneven regulation. Mortality rates of 30–50% would devastate populations and critical infrastructure. Advances in synthetic biology enable recreating variola (smallpox) and modified strains that evade vaccines; antimicrobial resistance risks tens of millions of future deaths. Historical incidents like 1984 Oregon salmonella attack and the 1995 Tokyo sarin attack illustrate security vulnerabilities. Covid-19 origin remains debated, with some citing a Wuhan Institute of Virology leak. A new pandemic is deemed inevitable in coming decades, with H5N1 spillover risk.

triage.headline_ja: テロリストが改変されたウイルスを使用して何百万もの犠牲者を引き起こす可能性があり、なぜ新しいパンデミックが差し迫っているのか
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は仮説的なバイオテロリズムシナリオと将来のパンデミックリスクに関する専門家の警告であり、進行中の実際の感染症アウトブレイクではない。現在の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す具体的な疾患発生事例を報告していない。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的インシデント（1984年オレゴン州サルモネラ事件、1995年東京サリン事件）およびCOVID-19起源の議論に言及しているが、現在進行中の感染症イベントではなく、仮説的なバイオセキュリティリスクに関する意見記事である。Bluedot APIが付与した複数の疾患名（痘瘡、パラチフス、H5N1、COVID-19、ニパウイルス、チフス、エボラ）は将来の脅威シナリオの例示であり、現在の確認されたアウトブレイク報告ではない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Jūrų gėrybių mėgėjams - baugi žinia: plinta virusas, nuo kurio galite apakti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Grim News for Seafood Lovers: A Virus Is Spreading That Could Make You Go Blind.
article.articleSummary: Chinese researchers report the first human nodavirus infections linked to aquatic animals, published in Nature Communications. Analyzing 70 patients (2022–2025) with persistent ocular hypertension and viral anterior uveitis, all were nodavirus-positive. Patients exhibited severe eye inflammation and elevated intraocular pressure with glaucoma-like symptoms; about one-third required emergency surgery, and one patient permanently lost sight. More than half kept home aquaculture and ~16% consumed raw seafood. Experimental mouse studies showed nodavirus caused retinal, corneal, and iris damage within a month, with transmission possible via shared water. While no confirmed human-to-human cases exist, some patients had no direct contact with marine animals, suggesting possible spread through shared utensils or close contact. In testing 523 aquatic animals, the virus appeared in 49 species, including fish, shrimp, crabs, and sea cucumbers, underscoring broad animal reservoirs and ocular-specific pathogenicity in humans.

triage.headline_ja: シーフード愛好家に悪朗報：失明を引き起こす可能性のあるウイルスが蔓延している
triage.triage_reason: 新規病原体（ノドウイルス）の人間感染が初めて報告され、重症度が高く（永続的失明例、緊急手術が1/3）、動物から人間への感染リスクと潜在的ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が示唆されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 新規の水生動物由来ノドウイルスとされ、2022-2025年に70例の患者が確認されている。永続的失明例、重篤な眼炎症、49種類の水生動物でウイルスが確認されている。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されていないが、直接的な接触なしで感染した患者も存在し、共用食器や近接接触を通じた拡大の可能性が示唆されている。水産物消費や家庭での水産養殖との関連が報告されており、シーフード産業全体への影響の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Emerging class of antibiotics to tackle global TB crisis
article.articleSummary: Drug-resistant tuberculosis remains a global crisis, claiming about 1.2 million lives each year, with rising resistance in the Asia-Pacific region. In 2026, researchers from the University of Sydney and the Centenary Institute report that a promising class of natural product antibiotics—ecumicin, ilamycin, and cyclomarin—disrupts the ClpC1-ClpP1P2 protein degradation machinery in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The ClpC1-ClpP1P2 complex is essential for removing damaged proteins and enabling TB survival under stress, making it an attractive drug target. Across experiments measuring changes in over 3,000 proteins, each compound perturbs the system differently, producing widespread proteome imbalances and weakening bacterial function. Published in Nature Communications (Barter et al., 2026), the findings underline a potential path to expand the anti-TB drug pipeline, including options against drug-resistant strains, with implications for TB control in the Asia-Pacific region.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の世界的危機に対抗する新しいクラスの抗生物質
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核治療の新規抗生物質開発に関する研究成果の報道であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、科学的進展の紹介である。シグナルトリアージの対象とするべき新規疾患イベント、異常な発生報告、または管理可能性の危機を含まない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規抗生物質の研究成果を報告したものであり、実在するアウトブレイクイベント（新規症例、異常な増加、地域での流行）を記述していない。Asia-Pacific地域での耐性TB増加への言及はあるが、具体的な新規クラスター報告や急速な拡大を示す証拠がない。Bluedot APIが China と Australia を列挙しているが、China における具体的なイベント発生の記述がないため、記事サマリーの主題から判断して China のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: LKC Dompet Dhuafa Jateng bersama Puskesmas Pejagoan skrining suspek TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LKC Dompet Dhuafa Central Java and Pejagoan Public Health Center Screen TB Suspects
article.articleSummary: TB screening of 37 toddlers in Kuwayuhan Village, Pejagoan Subdistrict, Kebumen Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, as part of the Desa Serbu TB program to accelerate tuberculosis elimination. LKC Dompet Dhuafa Central Java and Puskesmas Pejagoan conducted Mantoux tuberculin skin tests after measuring weight, height, and nutrition. Results were scheduled to be read on April 17, 2026. The initiative emphasizes early TB detection in vulnerable under-five children and its impact on growth and nutrition. The program seeks to expand access, boost community participation, and strengthen cross-sector collaboration, with envisaged tools to monitor TB treatment adherence and reduce loss to follow-up. Officials cited include Kuwayuhan Village Head Akhmad Mujamil Mustofa; Dr. Septian Choirul (Puskesmas Pejagoan); LKC head Titi Ngudiati; program implementer Siti Nur Rahmah. This effort aligns with Indonesia’s TB elimination targets and requires ongoing Kebumen District Health Office support.

triage.headline_ja: LKC Dompet Dhuafa中部ジャワとPejagoan保健センター、結核疑い患者をスクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: 結核の予防的スクリーニング・検診活動であり、新規発生事例の報告ではない。疾病サーベイランス、異常性、国際的拡大の可能性、重症度いずれの基準も満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核排除加速化プログラム（Desa Serbu TB）の一環として、インドネシア・ケブメン県で実施された予防的スクリーニング活動の報告である。確定診断例や死亡例、急激な増加、国境を越えた拡大のリスクは報告されていない。定期的な健康教育活動であり、シグナル要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan ghi nhận 23 ca tử vong do bệnh 'sốt đất'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand reports 23 deaths due to 'land fever' disease.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (soil fever) is spreading in Thailand, with 23 deaths among 732 nationwide cases this year. Burkholderia pseudomallei bacteria thrive in soil and water and infect people via wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust, or ingestion of contaminated water. The northeast farming belt is hardest hit, with Khon Kaen, Maha Sarakham, Roi Et, and Kalasin provinces reporting cases; Khon Kaen accounts for 68 cases and 2 deaths this year. Most patients are aged 50 and older. Symptoms range from fever, shortness of breath, and chest tightness to swollen or infected wounds; bacteremia can cause septicemia and death. Early medical evaluation is crucial. High-risk groups include farmers and others exposed to soil and water, plus diabetics, kidney disease, thalassemia, or immunodeficiency. Protective gear (boots, gloves) is advised during soil or water contact, per government spokesperson Lalida Periswiwatana.

triage.headline_ja: タイが土壌熱病（メリオイドーシス）による23人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスはタイで732症例、死亡23例の深刻な流行を示しており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当。また農業地帯での風土病的拡大とハイリスク集団の特定が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に適合する。
triage.notes: タイの北東部農業地帯（カラシン県、ロイエット県、コンケン県など）での集中的な発生が確認されている。土壌・水経由の環境伝播リスク、農民などのハイリスク集団の特定、及び政府スポークスパーソンによる公式コメントが存在することから、政府の関心も高い。国際的広がりのリスク評価には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PT Petrosea Bantu Dinkes Mimika Keroyok Nyamuk Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PT Petrosea Helps Mimika Health Office Tackle Malaria-Carrying Mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: As of 19 April 2026, malaria prevention efforts in Mimika, Central Papua, Indonesia, involve PT Petrosea Tbk partnering with the Mimika Regency Health Office to curb malaria transmission by distributing hundreds of mosquito nets in Kampung Damai, Kwamki Narama District. The CSR initiative targets ring-one areas around company operations to shield residents from Anopheles mosquitoes carrying malaria parasites. External Manager Reynold Dony Kabiai said the collaboration with health authorities aims to reduce malaria prevalence, with about 300 nets planned for Kampung Damai and continued distribution to other communities in Mimika, including Nayaro and additional areas as needed. The report does not provide malaria case or death counts, but the program is expected to lower malaria incidence in the endemic region and supplement local public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: PT Petrosea、ミミカ保健局がマラリア蚊対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: マラリア予防キャンペーンの報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾病増加、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す客観的根拠がない。具体的な患者数・死亡数が報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア予防・蚊対策の企業CSR活動を報道したものであり、新たなアウトブレイク情報ではない。患者数、死亡数、罹患率の増加などの感染症イベント指標が全く報告されていない。ミミカ地域は風土病地域（endemic region）であるが、この報道のみではシグナルを構成しない。

article.articleHeadline: 泰国"泥土病"感染显著增加：3个多月内23人死亡，50岁以上为易感染群体_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's "soil-borne disease" infections rise sharply: 23 deaths in just over three months, those aged 50 and above are an at-risk group.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Burkholderia pseudomallei) infections in Thailand rose sharply in early 2026, with 732 laboratory-confirmed cases and 23 deaths from Jan 1–Apr 16, 2026. The northeast region, notably Khon Kaen Province, reported 68 cases and 2 deaths. People aged 50+ are most at risk, including agricultural workers. The bacterium thrives in tropical, wet soils—rice paddies and muddy water—as primary exposure occurs via contaminated soil/water through broken skin or inhalation; aerosols can spread after storms. Transmission person-to-person is rare. Clinical manifestations are diverse, from fever, cough, chest pain, and skin ulcers to pneumonia, sepsis, meningitis, and abscesses. Risk factors include diabetes and chronic diseases; no vaccine exists. Prevention emphasizes protective gear for wet soil exposure and early antibiotic treatment; laboratory confirmation is required for diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: タイ国の「泥土病」感染が急増：3ヶ月強で23人死亡、50歳以上が易感染群
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急増、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。2026年1月〜4月で732例、死亡23例という重大な増加傾向。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシス（Burkholderia pseudomallei）は環境由来感染症で、熱帯地域で土壌・水の汚染により季節的に増減するが、今回の増加は異常。東北部（コンケーン県など）で集中。50歳以上、糖尿病患者が高リスク。人人感染は稀だが、環境汚染の継続リスクが高い。タイ政府による対応状況の追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak di DIY di Atas Angka 100
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in the Special Region of Yogyakarta exceed 100
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in the Special Region of Yogyakarta (DIY), Indonesia, have reached 112 as of 6 April 2026, with no deaths reported. The DIY Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan DIY) notes ongoing monitoring via the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR). The rise is attributed to mass travel during holidays and Eid al-Fitr, plus pandemic-related delays in immunization and vaccine hesitancy. Despite high herd immunity (MR first dose 98%, second dose 96%), gaps in complete immunization remain. Early measles symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, and red eyes, followed by a facial rash that spreads downward. Complications can be serious, especially in infants or the immunocompromised. Prevention centers on completing MR or MMR vaccination on schedule, with education through puskesmas, posyandu, schools, and media to counter misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ特別地域のはしか症例が100例を超える
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのジョグジャカルタ地域で112例のはしか患者が報告されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、死亡例がなく重症度に関する詳細情報が不足しているため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドネシア（ジョグジャカルタ地域）が明確に主題。112例の報告があり、ワクチン接種率の低下やホリデーシーズンの移動が原因とされている。死亡例がないため重症度は評価困難だが、ワクチン接種率の低下と人口移動により流行しやすい環境が指摘されている。継続的な監視体制が確立されている。

article.articleHeadline: Gene-Modified Males Could Collapse Malaria Mosquito Populations
article.articleSummary: Gene-drive–based release of genetically modified male Anopheles mosquitoes could collapse malaria vectors across Africa, a development watched as World Malaria Day nears April 25, according to Imperial College London researchers led by Target Malaria. The CRISPR-based system biases inheritance to nearly 100%, spreading a modification that targets the doublesex gene and renders females sterile. In large laboratory cages mimicking natural conditions, modified males mated with wild females, progressively suppressing egg production until populations collapsed within a year. In December 2025, a related sex-distorter drive combined with a doublesex target eliminated caged populations of Anopheles gambiae. The four primary malaria vectors—An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis, and An. funestus—drive progress across Africa, though no field release has occurred; regulatory approvals are required, and Burkina Faso suspended Target Malaria in Aug 2025. Ghana and Tanzania continue environmental studies and community engagement. Malaria remains deadly: ~610,000 deaths in 2024, ~95% in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 遺伝子改変オスがマラリア蚊個体群を破壊する可能性
triage.triage_reason: マラリア媒介蚊の遺伝子ドライブ技術開発に関する報道。現在のところ野外放出は実施されておらず、規制承認待機中だが、アフリカでの実装が予定されており、公衆衛生への潜在的影響と国際的な関心が高い。情報の十分な整理と継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は遺伝子ドライブ技術の開発段階に関する報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、革新的な媒介蚊対策の技術開発を扱っている。ブルキナファソとタンザニアも記事に言及されているが、検証可能な対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはGhanaのみとした。IHR基準は技術の潜在的な公衆衛生影響に基づいて評価。野外放出がまだ実施されていないため、現段階ではWATCHに分類し、規制承認プロセスと野外試験の進捗を継続監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Nông nghiệp cảnh báo virus lở mồm long móng chủng mới, độc lực mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture warns of a new foot-and-mouth disease virus strain with high virulence.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) caused by the SAT1 serotype, a highly virulent strain historically confined to Africa, has spread to the Middle East, Western Asia, and China. This increases the risk of entry into Vietnam via cross-border animal and animal-product trade. FMD affects cloven-hoofed livestock—buffalo, cattle, pigs, goats, and sheep—with SAT1 capable of near-100% attack rates in unvaccinated herds; adult mortality 1–5%, and over 20% in young calves due to severe cardiac complications. Vietnam currently reports no SAT1 circulation; vaccines in use cover serotypes O, A, and Asia1, offering no protection against SAT1, signaling a high outbreak risk if introduced. Since 2025, SAT1 outbreaks have occurred in several countries, most recently China with hundreds of cattle cases. The Ministry is strengthening border surveillance, sampling, and movement controls, coordinating veterinary, police, and border agencies, and pursuing emergency vaccine imports and domestic SAT1 vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省が新種の口蹄疫ウイルス株の警告を発表、病原性が強い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。高病原性SAT1株の中国侵入と東南アジアへの拡大リスクが存在し、ベトナムの脆弱性が高い。
triage.notes: SAT1型口蹄疫はアフリカ起源の高病原性株で、中国への侵入が確認され、ベトナムへの越境侵入リスクが高い。ベトナムの現行ワクチン（O、A、Asia1型）ではSAT1に対応できない。2025年以降、複数国での発生が報告されている。記事本文はないため、サマリーに基づき評価。

article.articleHeadline: Após saída da Força Nacional do SUS, DSEI assume combate à chikungunya nas aldeias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the SUS National Force's departure, DSEI takes over the fight against chikungunya in Indigenous villages.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak persists in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with 4,830 probable cases and eight confirmed deaths in the city, plus one death under investigation. The heaviest burden centers in the Indigenous Reserve of Dourados, particularly Jaguapiru and Bororó villages. The Força Nacional do SUS, deployed March 17, departs by April 18 after a month, as DSEI-MS takes over with about 50 endemic agents to intensify vector control in the two villages. UBSIs will operate with no lunch breaks and Saturday shifts to maintain care. Federal and municipal authorities declared a state of emergency to enable intervention. By April 4, the Força Nacional treated over 1,400 people in the Indigenous Reserve, moved 96 patients to hospitals, and visited 250 homes. Mato Grosso do Sul reports 201.2 chikungunya cases per 100,000 and 12 of 19 nationwide deaths (63%), with MS accounting for 5,882 of 28,888 probable national cases.

triage.headline_ja: SUS国家部隊の撤退後、DSEIは先住民村のチクングニア対策を引き継ぐ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア流行は複数のIHR基準を満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（4,830例、8死亡）、国家的異常性（緊急事態宣言、国家部隊の派遣）、国内ヒト-ヒト感染の継続が確認される。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないが、イベント情報の発生地域として記載されているため verified_locations に含めた。チクングニア流行はドゥアラドス市の先住民地域に集中。緊急事態宣言が発出され、保健当局による積極的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 农林牧渔行业周报：生猪价格底部反弹，关注动物疫病...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agriculture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry and Fishery Industry Weekly: Hog prices bottom out and rebound; monitor animal diseases.
article.articleSummary: Weekly snapshot (2026-04-13 to 2026-04-17) shows hog prices continuing to fall under supply pressure; average slaughter weight ~128.5 kg/head. Short-term declines may persist as policy-driven capacity cuts and ample supply keep margins below break-even, though sentiment appears to bottom. Long-run profitability remains for leading pig producers amid post-African swine fever expansion, with Muyuan Foods and Wen’s as top names. Poultry remains weak: white-feather (broiler) prices pressured by ample supply; yellow chickens marginally profitable; overseas avian influenza persists as a market disruptor. In cattle/dairy, Shandong live cattle price rose 0.7% WoW to 27.44 yuan/kg; beef prices are expected to rise aided by import-beef measures; dairy cows around 3.02 yuan/kg with improving balance. Risks include animal disease outbreaks (ASF, overseas avian influenza) and delays in GM corn adoption, potentially driving price volatility.

triage.headline_ja: 農業・林業・畜産・漁業業界週報：豚肉価格が底値から反発、動物疫病に注視
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱と鳥インフルエンザが市場リスク要因として言及されているが、具体的な新規発生事例、患者数、重症度の記述がなく、主題は経済・業界分析。シグナルとして識別する閾値を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は農業業界の経済分析（豚肉・家禽・牛乳価格）が主題であり、ASFと海外鳥インフルエンザはリスク要因として言及されているのみ。中国国内での新規発生確認、患者情報、疫学的詳細がなく、感染症イベントの公式報告ではない。続報にて具体的な患者発生例が報告される場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan cảnh báo bệnh melioidosis: 23 Người tử vong và 732 ca mắc năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand Warns of Melioidosis: 23 Dead and 732 Cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 732 melioidosis cases and 23 deaths nationwide as of 16 April 2026, with Region 7 (Khon Kaen area) recording 68 cases and 2 deaths. Melioidosis is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, found in soil and water, and can enter the body via wounds, inhalation, or ingestion of contaminated water. High-risk groups include farmers, rice growers, outdoor workers, and individuals with diabetes, chronic kidney disease, liver disease, chronic lung disease, thalassemia, or immunocompromise. Most cases involve adults aged 50 and above. Risk is higher in rural, agricultural settings during the rainy season or floods. Symptoms vary by infection site but can include high fever, headache, myalgia, cough with sputum, dyspnea, skin abscesses, or wound infections; septicemia can cause shock and death. Early diagnosis and treatment improve outcomes; preventive measures include wearing boots and gloves, avoiding water with wounds, drinking clean water, and seeking care for persistent fever or respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タイがメリオイドーシスに警告：2026年に23人死亡、732例の感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、地域的拡大リスク）。農業従事者や免疫不全者を含む高リスク集団への感染が多数報告されており、雨季・洪水時のリスク増加が指摘されている。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシス（類鼻疽）はBurkholderia pseudomalleiによる土壌・水由来感染症で、東南アジアの風土病。23例の死亡は症例確認報告から高い致命率を示唆。農業地帯での環境曝露リスクが高く、雨季・洪水シーズンでの拡大懸念あり。記事ではベトナムも言及されているため両国を verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ar saugu valgyti žalias jūros gėrybes? Su žalia žuvimi siejamas virusas gali pažeisti akis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is it safe to eat green seafood? A virus linked to green fish can damage the eye.
article.articleSummary: Aquatic-virus CMNV, previously confined to marine species, is linked to human viral anterior uveitis (VAU) with persistent ocular hypertension in China. In a 2022–2025 study, 70 VAU patients were analyzed; eye tissues from surgeries showed ~25-nanometer CMNV-like particles by electron microscopy, absent in healthy controls. CMNV-specific antibodies and genetic sequencing yielded a 98.96% match to aquatic strains, supporting zoonotic origin. Cell culture and laboratory mouse experiments demonstrated CMNV can induce disease with elevated intraocular pressure, resembling human symptoms. Nearly 75% of patients reported exposure to green seafood—either handling without gloves or consuming it raw—suggesting an exposure route. CMNV has been detected in 49 marine species across Asia, Africa, Europe, the Americas, and Antarctica, indicating wide distribution. This is the first study linking a waterborne virus to a specific human ocular disease, with implications beyond China.

triage.headline_ja: 緑色の海産物を食べても安全か？緑色の魚に関連するウイルスが眼を傷つける可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 新規の人獣共通感染症（CMNV）が中国で初めて眼疾患との関連が科学的に確認された。国際的な分布（アジア、アフリカ、ヨーロッパ、アメリカ、南極）と食品由来の曝露経路が確認され、異常/予想外な発見であり、国際的関心と支援の必要性がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに複数の不関連な場所（南極、アフリカ大陸など）が含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際のイベント発生地はChinaのみと判定。CMNVは広範に分布しているが、人眼疾患との関連が確認されたのは中国での2022-2025年研究が初。海産物を介した食品媒介感染の可能性が指摘されており、公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。

article.sourceUrl: http://www.epochtimes.com.tw/n500958/中國養殖蝦恐傳播病毒-疾管署-台灣風險極低.html
article.articleHeadline: 中國養殖蝦恐傳播病毒 疾管署：台灣風險極低| 台灣大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's farmed shrimp may spread the virus; Taiwan CDC says the risk is extremely low
article.articleSummary: CMNV, an emerging virus detected in aquatic animals, has recently appeared in China’s shrimp farms; Thailand has reported prior infections. There are no human cases reported globally, and WHO, CDC, and ECDC do not classify CMNV as a major public health threat. Taiwan’s CDC notes suspected human CMNV cases have occurred only in 18 Chinese aquaculture provinces; domestic monitoring shows no CMNV infections in Taiwan, and the overall human transmission risk is deemed extremely low. Taiwan’s Agricultural and Food Sanitation Administration confirms Taiwan shrimp farms have not detected CMNV to date. Ongoing surveillance and a human-specimen testing/early-warning framework will be maintained. Potential human infection could be linked to processing or consuming raw seafood; avoid raw seafood, wear gloves when handling raw products, and wash hands. No confirmed ocular CMNV cases in Taiwan; eye disease cases are not linked to CMNV; no need to panic.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の養殖エビがウイルス拡散の恐れ 台湾CDC「リスク極めて低い」
triage.triage_reason: CMNVは人での感染報告がなく、WHO/CDC/ECDCが主要な公衆衛生脅威として分類していない。台湾CDCが人への感染リスクを極めて低いと評価し、管理可能性が高い。
triage.notes: CMNVは水生動物で検出された新興ウイルスだが、世界的に人での感染報告なし。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。イベント記述は動物感染が主体で、人への転送リスクは極めて低いとの公式評価。警戒段階には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: मोहाली में HIV का बढ़ता खतरा; 3439 लोग संक्रमित, सावधानी न बरती तो स्थिति होगी गंभीर  - mohali hiv cases rise 3439 infected 454 new annually
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising HIV threat in Mohali; 3,439 people infected; if precautions are not taken, the situation will be serious
article.articleSummary: As of April 19, 2026, Mohali’s HIV burden is rising, with 3,439 people living with HIV in Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar and about 454 new cases annually. HIV prevalence stands at 0.381% in the district, categorized as a medium-priority public health concern. A recent Indian Estimation Technical Report attributes the uptick to factors linked with modern lifestyle, rapid population growth, and limited awareness about transmission and prevention. Without timely precautions and targeted interventions, the situation could worsen. The findings underscore the need for intensified prevention, expanded testing, and stronger linkage-to-care programs in Mohali to curb new infections and support people living with HIV.

triage.headline_ja: モハリのHIV増加の脅威；3,439人が感染；予防措置を講じなければ状況は深刻化する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: HIV は公衆衛生上の懸念事項だが、本事象は特定地域での流行状況の報告であり、直ちに国際的拡大や広域的脅威の証拠は示されていない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: インドのパンジャブ州モハリ地区におけるHIV患者数増加の報告。年間454例の新規感染、0.381%の地域有病率が報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性に該当するが、IHR基準では2つ以上に該当していない。社会的・政治的関心は存在するが、国際的拡大リスクは明記されていないため、段階的な経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Naše krev je pro komáry potrava číslo jedna. Hrozí nemoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Our blood is mosquitoes' number one food. Diseases threaten.
article.articleSummary: January 2026 study from the Oswaldo Cruz Institute in Rio de Janeiro shows mosquitoes increasingly feed on humans, shifting from birds and rodents to human blood due to habitat loss and climate change. Longer warm seasons and urbanization expand habitats, raising transmission risk of deadly tropical viruses not only in the tropics but also in Europe. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control warns the mosquito season is extended by about two months; the tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus) and others are spreading in Alpine cities and along the Mediterranean coast, with the Czech Republic’s State Health Institute monitoring the spread. Mosquito bites drive over a million deaths worldwide annually. In Europe, risk is higher for children, older adults, pregnant women, people with blood type O, and beer drinkers. Prevention: effective repellents, long sleeves/pants, eliminating standing water, lavender planting, and citronella or eucalyptus oils at home.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちの血液は蚊の第一の食料。病気の脅威
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の病気（Unknown Illness）による蚊媒介疾患の潜在的リスク増加についての記事。気候変動と都市化による蚊の行動変化は公衆衛生上の懸念だが、具体的な感染症発生事例や患者数が示されておらず、現時点での直接的な感染症イベント（confirmed outbreak）ではなく、リスク警告記事のため、情報不足のため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介疾患の潜在的リスク増加について論じているが、具体的な感染症アウトブレイク（confirmed cases/deaths）の報告ではない。Rio de Janeiroの研究機関データが主要な情報源であり、ブラジルが実際の研究対象国。Alpine、Greece、Czech Republicは蚊の地理的拡大の文脈でのみ言及されており、記事サマリー上では確定的な感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外。IHR基準は2つ該当（unusual且つinternational spread potential）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するが、具体的患者情報や発生状況の記述がないため、シグナル化よりも続報注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Maï-Ndombe : le gouverneur mobilise les églises pour vacciner les enfants contre trois maladies - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maï-Ndombe: the governor mobilizes churches to vaccinate children against three diseases - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Maï-Ndombe, Democratic Republic of Congo — Inongo: Governor Lebon Nkoso Kevani mobilizes churches to support a vaccination campaign against polio, measles, and rubella. From 22 to 26 April 2026, children aged 0–59 months will receive poliomyelitis vaccination, while those 6 months to 14 years will be immunized against measles and rubella, across the province. The initiative, in partnership with technical and financial partners, provides free vaccines as the most effective protection for children. Vaccination sites will be deployed in neighborhoods, health centers, schools, churches, markets, and other accessible locations. Parents and guardians are urged to bring unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated children to nearest health centers to complete immunization schedules, ensuring broad coverage during the province-wide drive.

triage.headline_ja: マイ=ンドンベ州：知事が教会を動員して3つの病気に対するワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施

article.articleHeadline: First Monkeypox Case Reported in Antioquia, Colombia - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: First confirmed mpox case reported in Colombia's Antioquia department (Medellín) as of 2026-04-19. A male adult presented with fever, rash, and lymphadenopathy; monkeypox virus confirmed by PCR at the National Institute of Health. The patient is in isolation and receiving care; contact tracing is underway. MinSalud stresses that this single case does not indicate sustained community transmission; Colombia's enhanced surveillance since the 2022-2023 outbreak enabled rapid detection and response. The infected individual carries the Clade I variant, associated with more severe outcomes and endemic in parts of Central/West Africa; Clade I has recently appeared in outbreaks linked to eastern DRC and neighboring regions. Genomic sequencing is ongoing to characterize the strain and assess links to Africa. No nationwide mpox vaccination campaign has been launched; vaccination stockpiles exist through international mechanisms. Authorities emphasize early detection, reporting, and protective measures for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアのアンティオキア州で初のサル痘症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・予想外性）。Clade Iの確認と中央アフリカとの関連性により、国際的に懸念される変異株の出現。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 対象国限定評価：記事の主題はコロンビアのMpox初症例だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。記事サマリーではDRC東部との関連性が明記されており、Clade Iの出現地との連関が重要。コロンビアは対象国外のため除外。DRCはClade I流行関連地域として検証ロケーションに含める。国際的なシグナル価値は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn nguy cơ xâm nhập virus lở mồm long móng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Preventing the incursion of foot-and-mouth disease virus.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) poses an incursion risk for Vietnam from serotype SAT1, which has moved from Africa to the Middle East and West Asia, with Iraq reporting SAT1 since March 2025 and China confirming 219 cattle cases in Gansu and Xinjiang in early April 2026. Vietnam has not yet detected SAT1; currently used vaccines cover serotypes O, A, and Asia1 only, leaving SAT1 unprotected. If introduced, the disease could cause substantial losses to cattle and buffalo populations. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development calls for strengthened surveillance, rapid testing, early outbreak detection and zoning, and immediate containment; tighter controls on movement, trade, slaughter, and products at borders, checkpoints, and markets; coordinated action among veterinary services, police, border troops, market authorities, and local governments; public outreach on biosecurity and safe sourcing. Centrally, authorities seek enhanced imports/exports oversight, vaccine stockpiling, emergency vaccine import planning, and domestic vaccine development, with resource allocation and interagency support.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫ウイルスのベトナム侵入リスクを防止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限リスク）。FMDはアフリカから中東・西アジアへ拡大し、イラクで確認後、中国で219頭の確認。ベトナムは現在未検出だが侵入リスク高く、ワクチン効果なし。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム当局による公式警告文。中国でのFMD SAT1確認（甘粛・新疆、219頭）がベトナムへの侵入リスクを顕在化させている。ベトナムの現有ワクチンはSAT1をカバーしていない。FAOでの国際的なFMD SAT1監視対象イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Em 24h, Dourados tem 60 novos casos confirmados de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In 24 hours, Dourados has 60 new confirmed chikungunya cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 April 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 60 new confirmed chikungunya cases in the last 24 hours, pushing the city’s total confirmed above 2,000. The state has 12 confirmed chikungunya deaths, about 63% of Brazil’s 19 total, with eight deaths in Dourados, the outbreak’s epicenter in the state. Dourados has 6,147 notifications: 5,096 probable cases, 2,022 confirmed, 3,074 under investigation, and 1,051 discarded. Among confirmed deaths, seven indigenous people, two infants, and five adults (elderly) are listed. Deaths under investigation include one indigenous 12-year-old child and one 84-year-old non-indigenous man with coronary artery disease. Data come from the epidemiological bulletin released by the Dourados City Hall on Sunday.

triage.headline_ja: 24時間で、ドウラードスは60件の新たに確認されたチクングニア熱症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドウラードス市でチクングニア熱が急速に拡大中。24時間で60件の新規確認例、累計2,000件超、12名の死亡（うち8名がドウラードス）が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の異常増加）に該当し、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: ドウラードス市はマットグロッソドスル州のチクングニア熱流行の中心地。先住民7名を含む死亡例、乳幼児2名の死亡も含まれており、脆弱層への影響が顕著。蚊媒介感染症であり、地域内での感染継続リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: MinSalud confirmó un primer caso de mpox Clado Id, variante de la viruela símica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirmed the first mpox Clade Id case, a variant of monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: First mpox Clade Ib case identified in Colombia’s Antioquia department, as part of ongoing surveillance; this follows the country’s prior mpox experience since 2022 with 4,825 laboratory-confirmed cases through epidemiological week 13, 2026, all belonging to Clade II. The Clade Ib identification was achieved through molecular biology techniques targeting conserved genetic regions. No additional cases or transmission chains have been identified to date; authorities say the finding does not alter the overall population risk, given no evidence of community transmission and strict monitoring. Mpox is a viral disease causing skin lesions commonly on the face, hands, and feet, transmitted via close physical contact, including skin-to-skin contact and sexual contact. In August 2024, the WHO Director-General declared Clade Ib mpox a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to rapid regional/global expansion, notably in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and surrounding areas.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO宣言済みPHEIC疾患の新クラド初検出は重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados promove atividades para conscientizar alunos sobre a Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados promotes activities to raise awareness among students about Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil persists, prompting school-focused prevention efforts. The municipality, with the Education Secretariat (Semed) and Civil Defense, launched the Defense Civil in Schools program to educate students on Chikungunya and how to curb Aedes aegypti breeding. Actions target facilities deemed critical where entomological surveillance notes rising mosquito foci, aiming to empower students as multipliers to disseminate prevention messages at home. Semed activities include school-based gincanas (competitions) and lectures on eliminating breeding sites, alongside distribution of informational materials during school hours. As of the Epidemiological Report released Friday, April 17, 2026, Dourados reports 4,919 probable Chikungunya cases, 1,858 confirmed, 1,003 discarded, and 3,061 under investigation, across 5,922 notifications with a 64.9% positivity rate.

article.articleHeadline: German pork import ban lifted after ASF regionalization deal - BusinessWorld Online
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-19, the Philippines’ Department of Agriculture lifted its 2020 ban on imports of swine products from Germany, under a bilateral ASF regionalization deal. Circular No. 18 recognizes Germany’s ASF-free zones and veterinary oversight, allowing exports from designated zones. Administrative Circular No. 12, Series 2025, sets guidelines for bilateral regionalization of African Swine Fever among accredited exporters. Under the regionalization rules, live swine must originate from ASF-free zones, show no clinical signs, and avoid restricted areas during transport. Pork products must come from ASF-free regions, be shipped in sealed vehicles directly to approved slaughterhouses, and pass ante- and post-mortem inspections. Exporting authorities must provide surveillance/control reports and define ASF-free region boundaries. Implicated location: Germany; importing country: Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: ASF地域化合意後、ドイツの豚肉輸入禁止が解除 - BusinessWorld Online

triage.notes: 本記事は2020年のASF禁止措置の解除を報じるもので、新たな感染症危機や疾病拡大ではなく、地域化合意に基づく貿易正常化の実施に関するもの。ドイツは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations にはフィリピンのみを列挙。シグナルピックアップの基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza H5N1: Know the Symptoms, Prevention, and What You Should Do - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: India confirmed an H5N1 avian influenza outbreak at a poultry training center in the Hesaraghatta region, prompting rapid containment. As of 19 April 2026, authorities culled thousands of poultry and destroyed eggs and contaminated feed. A 3-km infected zone and 10-km surveillance zone were established around the site, with household visits and fever monitoring in the field. No human cases have been reported, and officials say the situation is under control with preventive measures effectively enforced. H5N1, a highly pathogenic influenza A virus, mainly affects birds; human infection occurs via direct contact with infected birds or contaminated surfaces, with limited human-to-human transmission. Symptoms include fever over 38°C, cough, sore throat, muscle pains, fatigue, breathing difficulty, vomiting/diarrhea, and conjunctivitis; severe disease can cause pneumonia or ARDS. Preventive guidance emphasizes avoiding contact with sick birds, thorough cooking of poultry products, hand hygiene, and prompt reporting of flu-like symptoms after exposure.

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa mostra que ultrassom pode eliminar vírus da influenza A e da Covid-19 sem danificar células humanas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study shows that ultrasound can eliminate influenza A virus and COVID-19 without damaging human cells.
article.articleSummary: High-frequency ultrasound (3–20 MHz) induces acoustic resonance that inactivates enveloped viruses such as SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A (H1N1) by causing structural rupture of the viral envelope without heating or pH changes, sparing human cells. In vitro work from the University of São Paulo (USP) and collaborators, published in Scientific Reports, shows spherical enveloped virions absorb energy leading to internal vibrations that destabilize the envelope and inactivate the virus. The effect is geometry-driven and mutation-insensitive, so variants like Omicron or Delta should not affect efficacy. Ongoing tests extend to dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. This approach is a potential antiviral treatment, not a decontamination method, described as a green strategy with no residues. Research teams include IFSC (São Carlos), FMRP-USP (Ribeirão Preto), FCFRP-USP, UNESP; with Charles Rice (Rockefeller University) providing fluorescent viruses for real-time visualization.

article.articleHeadline: Colombia Confirms First Case of Mpox Clade Ib Variant - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Colombia confirms mpox case caused by the Ib subclade of monkeypox virus (clade I). The patient from Antioquia department presented with fever, headache, myalgias, fatigue, and a rash progressing from macules to papules, vesicles, pustules, and scabs; lesions were on the face, limbs, genitalia. He was isolated after diagnosis, and contact tracing found no secondary cases; case considered imported or sporadic as of mid-April 2026. Transmission via close contact with infectious lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials; respiratory droplets can spread during face-to-face contact, but casual contact poses minimal risk. Public health officials say risk remains low. MinSalud notes genetic sequencing links Ib to strains in the DRC and neighboring countries; further genomic analysis is needed to assess transmissibility or virulence. JYNNEOS vaccine offers protection against clade I and II; Colombia maintains a limited stockpile for high-risk groups; mass vaccination not recommended. No evidence of altered antiviral response to tecovirimat.

article.articleHeadline: Fugitive Lab Technician Arrested in HIV Blood Transfusion Case Jamshedpur
article.articleSummary: Jamshedpur, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand — A fugitive lab technician, Manoj Kumar of Ranchi, was arrested about 70 days after an FIR was filed on February 7 this year in connection with the transfusion of HIV-positive blood to five children with thalassemia at Sadar Hospital, Chaibasa, in October last year. The Jharkhand high court had ordered the FIR registration on February 4, prompting the parents of the affected children to file complaints. Sadar police station officer in-charge Tarun Kumar said the accused will be thoroughly interrogated. Following the case, the state government suspended West Singhbhum civil surgeon and hospital in-charge Dr Sushanto Majhee and removed Kumar from his job. The case is currently pending a hearing before the Jharkhand High Court.

article.articleHeadline: Mineração ilegal de ouro dispara surtos de malária em indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Illegal gold mining triggers malaria outbreaks among indigenous people.
article.articleSummary: Illegal gold mining in Brazil’s Yanomami territory of the Amazon sparked a severe malaria surge among the indigenous population. A multi-institution study by Stanford University, UFMT, and UFMG quantified the mining-malaria link: from 2016 to 2023, each 0.03% increase in mining corresponded to a 20–46% rise in malaria cases one to two years later, totaling about a 300% increase in Yanomami malaria incidence over the period. By 2023, illegal miners in the Yanomami territory reached roughly 20,000, with origins in malaria-endemic regions, suggesting parasite importation. Mechanisms include deforestation and riverbank clearings creating vector habitats, and mercury pollution contaminating water and fish, weakening immune defenses. Data from Brazil’s Ministry of Health enabled causal linkage. Under Lula, efforts to expel miners and establish health centers are underway; malaria hospitalizations declined slightly since 2023, but incidence remains high. Initiatives like malakit kits empower community members to diagnose and treat malaria locally.

triage.headline_ja: 違法金採掘がアマゾンの先住民マラリア流行を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのヤノマミ領土での違法金採掘に関連した重度のマラリア流行であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当するため。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事の主題がブラジルのヤノマミ領土での違法採掘関連マラリア流行であり、IHR基準3項目以上該当・WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当・社会政治的関心が高く、CEPR EBS活動の監視対象として重要なシグナルと判断される。スタンフォード大学などによる多機関研究による証拠ベースの因果関係確立、違法採掘者約20,000人の流入による地域システムへの重大な脅威、メドイロス政権下での対策実施状況があり、フルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul vai receber 46,5 mil doses da vacina contra chikungunya em meio a surto da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul Will Receive 46,500 Doses of the Chikungunya Vaccine Amid a Disease Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Amid a chikungunya outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, the state has received the first 20,000 of 46,500 doses of the world’s first chikungunya vaccine. The vaccine, developed by Valneva and Instituto Butantan and approved by Anvisa in April last year, is being deployed in a pilot through the National Immunization Program with donor doses; incorporation into the SUS is still under evaluation. While pilots target 18–59-year-olds, the doses will be allocated as follows: 43,500 to Dourados and 3,000 to Itaporã. Vaccination is set to begin on 27 April, with targets of 27.69% and 21.2% of the eligible populations in Dourados and Itaporã, respectively. The vaccine is not yet widely available nationwide; areas affected by the current outbreak are prioritized.

triage.headline_ja: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州、疾病の流行の中でチクングニア熱ワクチン46,500用量を受け取る

article.articleHeadline: Goiás declara emergência de saúde pública devido à Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave - Destak Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás Declares Public Health Emergency Due to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome - Destak Jornal
article.articleSummary: Goiás, Brazil, declared a 180-day public health emergency for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). As of 19 April 2026, 2,671 SRAG cases and 115 deaths were reported; infants up to two years accounted for 1,139 cases (42%), while those 60+ totaled 482 (18%). Influenza-related cases numbered 148, with 1,080 due to other viruses; circulation of the influenza variant K is noted. Decree creates an operations center, fast-track procurement, and temporary staff. Neighboring Distrito Federal (DF) monitors the situation; influenza variant K is predominant in South America, with no evidence of greater severity or vaccine failure. DF reports 67 influenza-associated SRAG cases, including one death. Fiocruz notes rising SRAG in children under 2 across four regions, driven by RSV. Vaccination campaigns continue: influenza vaccines for 6 months to under 6 years, elderly, and pregnant women; COVID-19 vaccine for infants at 6 months, with boosters for vulnerable groups; RSV vaccination offered to pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、重症急性呼吸器症候群により公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。多発地域での高い死亡率とRSVによる6歳未満児への顕著な影響により、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。ブラジルの複数州での監視体制構築が報告されており、政府の強い対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年4月19日時点のデータを報告。ゴイアス州での2,671件のSRAG症例（死亡115件）、特に6歳未満児の42%を占める1,139症例が報告されている。RSV循環による小児への影響が複数州（4地域）で確認されており、南米全域でのインフルエンザ変異株K流行の背景がある。ゴイアス州による180日間の公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、オペレーションセンター設置、迅速調達枠組みの創設など、政府レベルの対応が既に実装されている。隣接するディストリート・フェデラル（DF）の監視体制も並行稼働中。

article.articleHeadline: Outono acende alerta para gripe e alergias respiratórias em crianças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Autumn raises the alarm over flu and respiratory allergies in children.
article.articleSummary: Autumn signals rising influenza circulation in Brazil, with peaks April–June; in 2026, influenza A(H3N2) circulation is early. It need not mean a more severe outbreak, but reinforces prevention. The Brazilian Society of Pediatrics recommends vaccinating children and at‑risk groups (elderly, chronically ill, pregnant) early. Dr. Lívia Franco emphasizes vaccination as the best prevention, especially for children under five, due to developing immunity and high exposure in schools; kids may transmit to grandparents. SUS vaccination campaigns begin end of March and expand through basic health units; Instituto Butantan will deliver 70 million doses to ensure protection before case rise. Vaccine takes about two weeks to confer immunity; private clinics offer vaccines year‑round. Both SUS trivalent and private tetravalent vaccines are effective; vaccination does not cause flu. The season also worsens allergic rhinitis and asthma; maintain hydration, fever control, nasal saline, and seek care if respiratory distress, poor intake, or persistent fever.

article.articleHeadline: Herpes, gripe e mais: o que pode ser transmitido no beijo? - Observatório G
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Herpes, flu, and more: what can be transmitted through a kiss? - Observatório G.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-19, infectious disease expert Luís Arthur Brasil of Hospital São José in Ceará, Brazil (Secretaria da Saúde do Ceará) states that kissing can transmit several infections. Commonly transmitted conditions include herpes, infectious mononucleosis (the “kissing disease”) caused by Epstein-Barr virus, syphilis, and respiratory infections such as influenza and COVID-19. HIV is not transmitted by kissing; although viruses may be present in saliva, quantities are typically too low to cause infection through this contact. For herpes, transmission mainly occurs via direct contact with active lesions rather than saliva alone—visibility of sores increases risk. Saliva is not always the main transmission factor. Despite multiple potential transmissions, kissing is considered a low-risk form of intimate contact compared with unprotected sex.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza segue em circulação no país e reforça necessidade de prevenção anual - Agora MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza continues to circulate in the country and reinforces the need for annual prevention - Agora MT.
article.articleSummary: Influenza continues to circulate in Brazil, reinforcing the need for annual prevention. The World Health Organization estimates about 1 billion global seasonal flu infections annually, with 3–5 million severe cases and up to 650,000 deaths from respiratory complications. In 2025, Brazil recorded roughly 220,000 SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) cases per InfoGripe Fiocruz; among confirmed viral cases, about one in four involved influenza A, making it a leading cause of severe illness. As of mid-April 2026, InfoGripe reports rising influenza A occurrences and hospitalizations across much of the Central-Southern region and parts of the Northeast. Common symptoms include sudden fever, cough, headache, myalgia, sore throat, runny nose, and malaise; higher risk in the elderly, infants, and those with chronic or immunosuppressive conditions, with possible pneumonia or respiratory failure. Vaccination is recommended for all ≥6 months; 6–8-year-olds getting vaccinated for the first time require two doses (four weeks apart); from age 9, a single annual dose. The inactivated vaccine is produced from cultured, inactivated viral particles and stimulates antibodies without causing infection.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザは国内で流行し続けており、年1回の予防の必要性を強調 - Agora MT

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA型の定期的な流行として報告されており、「異常または予想外」の基準は満たさない。2025年の220,000件のSRAG症例、2026年4月時点での増加傾向が確認され、中央南部および北東部地域での発生が報告されている。脆弱集団（高齢者、乳幼児、免疫不全者）での重症化リスクが言及されている。ワクチン対策が整っているため、国家管理能力は高い。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ex-jogador de futebol morre aos 28 anos em Cachoeiro; suspeita é de leptospirose ou chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former footballer dies at 28 in Cachoeiro; the suspicion is leptospirosis or chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Former Brazilian footballer Jonathas Gonçalves Silva, 28, known as Babal, died on April 19, 2026, in Cachoeiro de Itapemirim, southern Espírito Santo. He had been hospitalized since April 17 at Santa Casa de Misericórdia de Cachoeiro de Itapemirim after seeking care at a UPA, undergoing tests, then returning the next day with hydration before transfer to hospital. Authorities confirmed the death with suspicion of leptospirosis or chikungunya. The municipality said it could not disclose patient details. The death prompted mourning from his former club Estrela do Norte, which noted his 2018 stint and contribution to the club’s ascent in capixaba football. No laboratory confirmation details were provided in the report.

article.articleHeadline: Daltonganj Jail Tuberculosis Screening: Portable X-Rays Used for Inmate Health
article.articleSummary: On 19 April 2026, Daltonganj central jail in Palamu district screened inmates for tuberculosis using two portable X-ray machines. Civil surgeon Dr Anil Kumar Srivastava stated that inmates with cough and fever for two weeks, weight loss, night sweats, or blood-stained sputum can be quickly screened, with results directly loaded into a computer for diagnosis. Jail superintendent Anant Kumar Jha said the facility houses over 800 inmates and that two Sundays were allocated for screening; more than 800 inmates were screened on Sunday, the first such screening effort at the central jail. Inmates testing positive for tuberculosis are entitled to Rs 1,000 per month for six months for treatment.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria Outbreak in Saranda Forest: CoBRA Jawans Battle Mosquitoes Amidst Anti-Naxal Operations
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak among CoBRA jawans in the Saranda forest, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand, with nine diagnosed malaria cases in the past six days and one fatality (Anand Singh, 44, 197 Battalion) who died in Ranchi; another jawan, Anil Biswal of 205 Battalion, was airlifted to Ranchi after high fever, chills and vomiting. Security forces are implementing vector-borne disease precautions as anti-Naxal operations continue. Saranda spans about 805 sq km and hosts saal forests that provide breeding grounds for female Anopheles mosquitoes; around 56 villages lie within, with roughly 20 reporting malaria regularly. In 2024, the district logged about 9,000 malaria cases. Officials cite poor living conditions in the hilly terrain as a major risk factor. Preventive measures include anti-malaria kits, insecticide-treated nets, repellents, pills, and wearing full-sleeved clothing; battalions have on-site medical staff. Historical context: malaria outbreaks affected security forces in 2011 and 2012.

article.articleHeadline: Goiás decreta emergência por surto de SRAG em bebês
