triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、乳幼児のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）アウトブレイクにより公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。ブラジルにおけるSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の大規模アウトブレイク（2,671件の通知、115人の死亡）であり、乳幼児に特に影響を与えており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクのいずれもが存在する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にCameroon、United States、Africaを含めているが、記事サマリーはブラジルのゴイアス州とディストリト・フェデラル（ブラジリア）での発生のみ記述しているため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。RSV関連の入院がブラジル北部・東北部でも報告されているが、アウトブレイクの主要な対象地域はブラジル国内。公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言と180日間の危機管理体制の実施により、対応能力の問題が予想される。

article.articleHeadline: Itaporã antecipa calendário e inicia vacinação contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itaporã advances the vaccination schedule and begins chikungunya vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination started in Itaporã, Mato Grosso do Sul, making it the state's first municipality to immunize against the disease. Itaporã received 3,000 doses; Dourados has 7,000 doses allocated so far. Combined, the two municipalities will receive 46,500 doses. The initial phase targets adults 18-59 without comorbidities, with Montese, Santa Terezinha, Carumbe and Pirapora districts active in the rollout (Montese 48 doses, Pirapora 10, Carumbe 6). The municipal bulletin reports 289 chikungunya notifications: 51 confirmed, 217 discarded, 21 under investigation; population 25,263, incidence 207.2/100k. The vaccine, developed by Instituto Butantan, is the world’s first chikungunya vaccine; 98.9% of 4,000 adult trial participants produced neutralizing antibodies; contraindicated in pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, or certain comorbidities. Federal support includes about 3.1 million reais, expanded urban cleaning, surveillance, and deployment of health teams to Dourados and indigenous communities; Forca Nacional active since March 17.

triage.headline_ja: イタポラが予防接種スケジュールを前倒しし、チクングニヤワクチン接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでチクングニヤの活発な流行が確認され、国家規模のワクチン対応が展開中。高い発生率（207.2/100k）、確定症例の増加、複数州での拡大、連邦政府の支援動員がIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの地域情報は正確。ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州およびマットグロッソ州でのチクングニヤ流行は確認されており、Instituto Butantanによる世界初のチクングニヤワクチンが展開されている。高い発生率と複数州への拡大、国家規模の対応がフルRRA実施の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue no Acre caem 81% em 2026, com 689 confirmações e nenhum óbito - O Alto Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases in Acre drop 81% in 2026, with 689 confirmed cases and no deaths - O Alto Acre
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Acre, Brazil, shows a sharp 2026 downturn through April 14: 1,171 probable dengue cases with 689 laboratory-confirmed, and no severe cases or deaths reported. Compared with the same period in 2025, when 6,161 probable and 5,624 confirmed cases were recorded, 2026 reflects an 81% drop in probable cases and an 87.75% drop in confirmed cases, with total confirmations remaining below 700 by April. The data come from Sesacre (Secretaria de Estado de Saúde). Despite the improvement, health authorities stress sustaining and intensifying epidemiological surveillance and vector control, given dengue’s seasonal pattern that can drive case increases in coming months. Details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are not provided; continued vigilance is essential to prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・アクレ州2026年デング熱患者数が81%低下、689件の確定症例と死亡ゼロ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱患者数が前年同期比で大幅に減少（81%低下）しており、死亡や重症例がない。既知の風土病の改善傾向を示しているため、緊急のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの既知の風土病であり、本記事は良好な制御状況を報告している。患者数の減少、死亡症例なし、重症例なしという点で、疾病制御の成功事例である。定期的な疫学監視と蚊媒介対策の継続が記事で言及されているが、これは通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内。国際的な拡大リスクやWHO通知の必要性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerte au choléra dans la zone de santé de Kibua à Walikale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera alert in the Kibua health zone in Walikale
article.articleSummary: Cholera flare-up in Kibua health zone, Walikale, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, with 56 suspected cases and 6 deaths reported since early March. Outbreak centers on Ntoto, Langira, and Kilungu health areas, disproportionately affecting children over five years. Transmission linked to mass displacement from fighting between AFC/M23 and Wazalendo in adjacent Masisi. Critical gaps include no potable water, sanitation facilities, or latrines, hindering containment. Medical supplies are limited; a small batch has been dispatched and partners’ support is requested. Laboratory samples have been sent to confirm cholera. The Red Cross has begun household decontamination and intensified community awareness. Health authorities stress strict hygiene measures to curb spread and contain the outbreak despite limited resources.

triage.headline_ja: ワリカレ地区キブア保健圏におけるコレラ警報
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で56例の疑い例と6死亡が報告されたコレラ流行。IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、社会的関心あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ワリカレ地区キブア保健圏でのコレラ流行を主題としている。アンゴラはBluedotにより付与されているが、記事本文にアンゴラへの言及がないため除外。武力紛争による大量避難民が感染拡大リスク要因。医療資源と基礎インフラの重篤な不足が対応能力を著しく制限している。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito transmissor da malária evolui e dribla resistência a inseticidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria-Transmitting Mosquito Evolves and Evades Insecticide Resistance.
article.articleSummary: Malaria-transmitting Anopheles darlingi shows genetic adaptation to insecticides, according to a Science paper published as of 19 April 2026, based on an international collaboration including USP's Public Health School (FSP). The team sequenced the full genomes of 1,094 female An. darlingi collected from 16 sites across French Guiana, Brazil, Guyana, Peru, Venezuela, and Colombia. The study finds signals of selection in cytochrome P450 genes, key mediators of metabolic insecticide resistance, suggesting resistant variants are favored under insecticide exposure. The work underscores that malaria control is transnational: vectors do not respect borders, and parasite and resistance gene flow complicates local strategies. For Brazil, findings support a strengthening of entomological surveillance and strategic insecticide use—monitoring efficacy continuously rather than abandoning chemicals. The collaboration also involved institutions like Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Broad Institute, and Wadsworth Center, governed by Nagoya Protocol compliance.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア媒介蚊が進化して殺虫剤抵抗性を回避
triage.triage_reason: マラリア媒介蚊の殺虫剤耐性遺伝子の広域的な確認は公衆衛生上の関心事だが、現在のところ新規感染アウトブレイク報告ではなく、遺伝学的研究成果であるため、直ちにピックアップは困難。対象国内（ブラジル）の発生確認を含むため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は科学論文（Science誌、2026年4月19日）の発表に基づくもので、複数国での蚊の遺伝子配列研究結果を報告。フランス領ギアナ、ブラジル、ガイアナ、ペルー、ベネズエラ、コロンビアで採集された蚊から殺虫剤耐性遺伝子の選別信号を検出。対象国はブラジルのみだが、複数国にまたがる公衆衛生上の懸念があり、IHR基準は3つ該当する。ただし現時点では新規患者数増加やアウトブレイク報告がないため、WATCHレベルとした。ブラジルの公衆衛生当局の対応方針も言及されているため社会政治的関心も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Londrina aposta em drones e aspiradores para conter mosquitos da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Londrina bets on drones and vacuum cleaners to curb dengue-carrying mosquitoes.
article.articleSummary: Londrina, in North Parana, Brazil, is expanding dengue control using drones to aerially inspect properties and map Aedes aegypti breeding sites, a pilot started in 2025 through a partnership between the Prefeitura de Londrina and Universidade Estadual de Londrina (UEL). Two drones conduct weekly mutirões and targeted actions, enabling access to hard-to-reach sites like abandoned pools and open water tanks. In 2026, suspected dengue case notifications fell from 10,162 to 5,847 (a 42.5% reduction), with no dengue deaths reported so far. Complementing drones, the city uses the 'Aspirador de Nasci' to capture mosquitoes for surveillance, storing specimens at -80°C and sending them to UFPR in Curitiba for RNA testing to detect dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. About 1,500 ovitrampas are installed with weekly monitoring. Over 50 workers remove standing-water risks, and dengue vaccination is freely available for children and adolescents aged 10–14 at health units.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドリーナがドローンと掃除機を使ってデング熱蚊を抑制することに賭ける
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州でデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニアの検査体制が整備されており、デング熱患者数の減少が報告されているが、大規模な流行や深刻な公衆衛生危機の兆候は明らかでない。情報の性質は技術的な対策報告であり、シグナルとしての要件は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのパラナ州ロンドリーナにおけるデング熱対策の技術的実装と成功事例を報道している。2026年に疑い例が42.5%減少し、死亡例なし。蚊媒介感染症の潜在的なリスク（長期曝露、流行性）は存在するが、現在は制御下にあり、危機段階ではない。ただし、複数の蚊媒介ウイルス（デング、ジカ、チクングニア）が検査対象であり、ベクター制御の継続が必要な状況であるため、WATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Urgent Action Needed on Rising HIV/AIDS Rates in East Khasi Hills
article.articleSummary: Over 10,293 HIV/AIDS cases have been reported in Meghalaya's East Khasi Hills district as of early 2026, one of India's highest caseloads. The surge disproportionately affects youth, linked to rapid digital media spread and a growing hookup culture that promotes risky sexual behaviours amid misinformation. The author calls for urgent, locality-based HIV/AIDS awareness programs and for integrating comprehensive sexual health education into school and university curricula, focusing on responsible relationships and self-respect. Immediate action by the state government and local authorities is urged to address this public health crisis before it further compromises community futures. The aim is to empower youth with accurate information and effective prevention strategies to curb transmission and reduce impact on the region's health and social well-being.

triage.headline_ja: 東カーシ丘陵地区におけるHIV/AIDS急増率への緊急行動が必要
triage.triage_reason: インド・メーガラヤ州の東カーシ丘陵地区でHIV/AIDS患者数が10,293例と急増しており、重症度基準、異常性基準、長期曝露基準に該当。州政府・地域当局への緊急対応呼びかけがあり、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は東カーシ丘陵地区（メーガラヤ州内）のHIV/AIDS危機に焦点。青年層への影響、ソーシャルメディアによるリスク行動の拡大、包括的性教育の欠如が報告されている。州政府への緊急対応呼びかけは政府レベルの注目を示唆している。ただし記事配信日（2026年4月）は将来日付のため、実際の配信時期確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Colíder moderniza combate ao mosquito Aedes aegypti com tecnologia de ponta e monitoramento digital " Notícia Exata - Notícias de Alta Floresta e Região!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Colíder City Hall modernizes the fight against the Aedes aegypti mosquito with cutting-edge technology and digital monitoring Notícia Exata - News from Alta Floresta and Region!
article.articleSummary: Colíder's City Hall, with the Municipal Health and Sanitation Secretariat, deploys Conta Ovos, a high-precision digital platform for monitoring Aedes aegypti. The system replaces manual larval surveys with geolocation and image processing to target interventions in neighborhoods with higher vector density, aiming to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. Result of a technical partnership among Instituto Oswaldo Cruz, Fundação Getúlio Vargas, and the Ministry of Health, it relies on ovitrampas—black pots with water, yeast and a wooden paddle that attract egg-laying females. Eggs are read after 20 days of deployment, collected on day five, and entered into the system. March saw 98 ovitrampas with 2,394 eggs; April, 107 traps with 3,319 eggs, raising the Egg Density Index from 42% to 61%. Critical areas include Boa Esperança, Jardim Ipanema, Centro, Jardim Alvorada, Sagrada Família, da Torre, Celídio Marques, Parque dos Ipês, and Comunidade Nova Galileia. Fumigation is limited to suspected cases; emphasis on eliminating breeding sites, household visits, and public education, aided by Fiocruz data integration.

triage.headline_ja: コリデール市がハイテク技術とデジタル監視でネッタイシマカ対策を現代化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるネッタイシマカ対策の技術導入事例であり、デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニアの監視強化を目的としている。ただし記事は対策・予防技術の展開報告であり、新たな疾患集積や異常事例の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は限定的だが、ベクター密度指数の上昇（42%→61%）が記載されており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の対策技術（Conta Ovos：卵密度指数監視システム）の導入事例であり、新規疾患クラスタやアウトブレイクの報告ではない。ただしネッタイシマカの卵密度指数が急速に上昇（42%→61%）している点は注視価値がある。ブラジルではデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニアは風土病であり、この地域的な媒介蚊密度増加がシグナルを示唆する可能性がある。続報によるアウトブレイク情報の有無を確認推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo virus lở mồm long móng chủng mới xâm nhập vào Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: New strain of foot-and-mouth disease virus has entered Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD), serotype SAT1, threatens Vietnam as SAT1—previously confined to Africa—has spread to the Middle East, West Asia, and China, with hundreds of cattle affected since 2025 (as of 19 April 2026). Vietnam, which has not yet detected SAT1, faces elevated risk due to cross-border trade and animal-product movement. Current vaccines in Vietnam cover serotypes O, A, and Asia1, but not SAT1, meaning introduction could trigger a large-scale outbreak with high morbidity in susceptible livestock. Adults show 1–5% mortality; calves may exceed 20% due to severe cardiac complications. Authorities urge synchronized, preventive measures: enhanced surveillance in border regions, prompt sampling, and immediate response to suspected cases; tightened transport, trading, and slaughter controls; crackdown on illegal animal and product import. Veterinary, police, border guards, and market inspectors must cooperate. Plans include vaccine import, stockpiling, and development of a domestic SAT1 vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：新種の口蹄疫ウイルスがベトナムに侵入
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1型の国際的な拡大（アフリカから中東・西アジア・中国に波及）、ベトナムでの発生リスク上昇、および家畜への高い罹患率・死亡率（子牛で20%超）がIHR基準3項目以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当しており、ベトナムでは予防的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムへのSAT1型口蹄疫の侵入リスク警告が主題。実際の確認例はアフリカ起源で中国・西アジア・中東に既に拡大。ベトナムはまだ検出されていないが、高リスク評価されている。中国では既に数百頭の牛が影響を受けている（2025年以降）。ワクチンギャップ（現在のワクチンはO型、A型、Asia1型のみでSAT1型なし）が懸念要因。記事の発信は獣医当局による予防的公開警告。

article.articleHeadline: ICU infections show alarming antibiotic resistance in Pune hospital study
article.articleSummary: ICU infections in Pune, India show alarming antimicrobial resistance. A hospital-based cross-sectional study of 247 Gram-negative isolates from ICU blood cultures (Jan 2023–Dec 2024) from BJMC-SGH Pune, published March 2026 in the National Journal of Laboratory Medicine, finds Klebsiella pneumoniae as the most common pathogen (27.5%), followed by Escherichia coli (20.6%); other isolates include Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Acinetobacter, Enterobacter, Citrobacter. Widespread resistance across penicillins, cephalosporins, and carbapenems; carbapenem resistance to meropenem nearly 70%; some isolates resistant to colistin. About 78% of K. pneumoniae isolates resistant to ceftazidime-avibactam. ICU infection rates are two- to five times higher than general wards due to prolonged stays and invasive devices. Authors urge hospital-specific AMR surveillance, strengthened antibiotic stewardship, and infection prevention; in line with WHO warnings of a post-antibiotic era.

triage.headline_ja: プネーの病院研究で ICU 感染症が危機的な抗菌薬耐性を示す
triage.triage_reason: 抗菌薬耐性(AMR)に関する重要な疫学調査だが、急性感染症アウトブレイクではなく医療施設内の既知の感染パターン分析であり、直ちの公衆衛生介入や国際的拡大を示唆する情報がない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察継続が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは単一病院の回顧的研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイク検出ではない。抗菌薬耐性の上昇は公衆衛生上重要だが、急性感染症危機ではなく長期的な医療システム課題である。WHO の AMR 警告との関連性は記事で言及されているが、直ちの国際的拡大リスクは示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Latest Zika Virus Updates from CDC and NIAID - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Zika virus updates from CDC and NIAID report ongoing risk for pregnant women and travelers. As of January 2016, local mosquito-borne transmission has been reported in multiple countries and territories across the Americas, including Brazil, Colombia, El Salvador, French Guiana, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Martinique, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Suriname, Venezuela, and Puerto Rico. Pregnant women are advised to postpone travel to areas with active transmission; travelers should implement mosquito bite prevention (EPA-registered repellents, long sleeves, screened or air-conditioned accommodations). Zika is mainly transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; sexual transmission has been documented in a limited number of cases. Most infections are mild or asymptomatic, but maternal infection during pregnancy is linked with microcephaly and other fetal brain defects. Research is ongoing on pathogenesis, vertical transmission, and potential neurological complications; no vaccine yet, with candidates in early-stage testing. Surveillance and rapid reporting to health authorities are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: CDC and NIAIDからのジカウイルスの最新情報 - News Directory 3
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2016年1月時点のジカウイルス情報の総括であり、新規の感染症イベント報告ではなく、過去情報の解説記事である。対象国リストに含まれる Brazil のみが記事に言及されているが、具体的な新発生の詳細や急迫性がなく、社会的関心を測定する現在時点の関連性も低い。
triage.notes: 記事は2016年1月時点のジカウイルスに関する一般的な情報提供・解説記事であり、新規イベント報告ではない。配信日時は2026年4月と記載されているが、本文内容は10年以上前の情報を参照している。Bluedotが検出した発生地域リストに含まれる対象国は Brazil のみであるが、記事は具体的な新発生報告ではなく履歴情報であるため、シグナル検知の対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh dại đang gia tăng tại nhiều địa phương, đặc biệt trong mùa nắng nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies on the rise in many localities, especially during the hot season.
article.articleSummary: Rabies is rising across Vietnam during the hot season, with outbreaks and dog bites reported in Hanoi, Quang Ngai, Dak Lak, Da Nang, and Ho Chi Minh City (Ba Ria–Vung Tau area). In Hanoi, two stray-dog rabies outbreaks were detected in Hoa Lac and Ha Bang, with four additional people bitten by suspected rabid dogs. On 14 April, Quang Ngai reported a stray dog injuring four along inter-village roads in Son Tinh before being culled. Dak Lak, amid the dry-season peak, has several dog-attack incidents and one rabies death this year, including a 3 April event with five bites in Phu Tho 3, Hoa Hiep. Da Nang recorded four outbreaks on pet dogs in Dong Duong, Son Cam Ha, and Thanh Binh. In Ho Chi Minh City, a 63-year-old man, H.M.D., died of rabies after a dog bite about a month earlier in Long Hai, Ba Ria–Vung Tau. Experts warn summer is rabies season; dog/cat vaccination should exceed 80%, with strict pet management and prompt post-exposure vaccination. Vietnam spends over 1 trillion VND annually on vaccines and immunoglobulin, with 70–90 rabies deaths yearly and about 7 million dogs/cats, only half vaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病が多くの地域で増加、特に猛暑の季節に
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム全土における狂犬病の多発報告であり、IHR基準における「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常/予想外な事象」の2項目に該当。年間70-90人の死亡が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」も満たされている。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにHenan Sheng（中国）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではベトナムの複数地域（ハノイ、クアンガイ、ダクラク、ダナン、ホーチミン市）のみが言及されており、中国での発生は確認されていないため除外。ベトナムにおける狂犬病は季節性がある既知の課題だが、本記事は複数地域での同時多発を報告しており、公衆衛生上の懸念として識別される。

article.articleHeadline: 记者：贺希宁患重度病毒性感冒 带病出战了两场比赛后病情加重了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reporter: He Xining contracted a severe viral influenza; after playing two matches while ill, his condition worsened.
article.articleSummary: In the CBA regular season, Shenzhen lost 95-103 to Shandong as He Xining was sidelined by a severe viral influenza. He initially contracted a cold during the away game against Xinjiang, did not improve, and returned home to play against Ningbo, where his condition worsened. Despite illness, he attended the Shandong game on-site, and at halftime his fever neared 39°C, yet he continued to endure through the match. The absence contributed to Shenzhen’s 15-game winning streak ending. With the regular-season finale against Guangzhou in four days, the team planned rest and further integration of a new foreign player. A road win over Guangzhou would clinch third place for Shenzhen. The report highlights the health toll of playing through a high fever and its impact on team outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 記者報道：何希寧選手が重度のウイルス性風邪を患い、病気を押して2試合に出場した後に病状が悪化した
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は個別のバスケットボール選手の風邪罹患に関するスポーツニュースであり、公衆衛生上の危機や異常な感染症イベントを示していない。インフルエンザの集団発生や地域規模での感染拡大の兆候がなく、社会的・政治的関心も感染症危機管理の対象外である。
triage.notes: 本記事はスポーツニュース（バスケットボール）のサイトに掲載された個別選手の罹患に関する記事。Bluedot APIが感染症関連キーワード（Influenza）に反応してピックアップされたと考えられるが、感染症危機管理の対象となる公衆衛生イベントではない。複数都市の記載があるのはバスケットボールリーグの試合地であり、感染症の地理的拡大を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Stalling the silent spread of TB cases
article.articleSummary: India notified over 26 lakh TB patients in 2025—the highest annual total—signaling progress toward elimination rather than a setback, as early diagnosis and full treatment reduce transmission. The country is cutting TB incidence at nearly twice the global average. Diagnosis now occurs closer to communities: portable handheld X-ray devices with AI enable on-the-spot screening in remote settings, while district-level molecular tests detect TB and drug resistance within two hours. A substantial share of detected patients under TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan had no symptoms, underscoring the importance of proactive screening. Future testing envisions rapid finger-prick triage, smartphone-based cough analysis, and non-sputum samples (tongue swabs, urine). Open-platform PCR and homegrown solutions promise results in under 60 minutes, up to 80% cheaper than standard PCR; Covid-era diagnostic platforms can screen TB alongside HIV and diabetes. Closing the detection gap is essential to ending TB.

triage.headline_ja: TB症例の静かな拡大を食い止める
triage.triage_reason: 記事は主にインドのTB診断技術の進歩と成功事例を報じるもので、新規発生イベントではなく公衆衛生対策の成果を扱っている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準における懸念指標が該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年のインドにおけるTB患者通知数の増加を報じているが、これは診断改善と早期治療による成功（incidence低下、transmission減少）を示すもの。新規感染症危機ではなく、既知疾患対策の進展を扱っているため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。COVID-19とHIVが併記されているのは診断プラットフォームの多目的利用言及に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana: Veterinary varsity experts warns of abortion risk linked to parasite toxocara in pet cats
article.articleSummary: Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University in Ludhiana warns rising pet ownership elevates toxocara parasite risk in cats, with abortion risk for pregnant women and feline skin infections such as scabies. Gurpreet Singh Preet, assistant professor (clinics), notes adoption of indigenous and foreign cats (including Persian breeds) increases exposure. Canine parvovirus is highlighted as highly contagious, affecting puppies under 45 days, with vomiting, fever and diarrhea; vaccination is the only effective protection, and it does not spread to humans. With summer, experts warn of a spike in fungal and skin infections among pets, especially exotic breeds less suited to local climate; indigenous breeds are more resilient. Dogs remain the most preferred pets; trends extend to birds (lovebirds, parakeets) and small animals (hamsters, guinea pigs, rabbits). Simple cooling measures, like sprinkling cold water, help prevent hyperthermia in extreme heat.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナ：獣医大学の専門家がペット猫の寄生虫トキソカラに関連した流産リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: 疾患はScabiesであるが、記事の主要な焦点はペット所有に伴う一般的な衛生上の注意喚起であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示す証拠がない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はペット所有時の寄生虫・皮膚感染症に関する教育的警告であり、実際の流行・集団発生報告ではない。Bluedot APIが疾患をScabiesと分類していますが、記事の主要焦点はトキソカラ（Toxocara）およびペット感染症一般に関する専門家による予防的アドバイスである。イランへの言及はBluedot APIの誤検出と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Cazul copilului suspectat că s-ar fi îmbolnăvit de rujeolă, confirmat. Școala pe care o frecventează nu are autorizație sanitară
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The case of the child suspected of having contracted measles has been confirmed. The school the child attends does not have sanitary authorization.
article.articleSummary: Lab-confirmed measles in an 8-year-old child in Chișinău, Moldova. The patient is unvaccinated and attends Excelsis, a private Christian school operating without sanitary authorization; the school reports the pupil presented with dermatitis and has not disclosed how many students are unvaccinated. In the same week, health authorities recorded 14 influenza cases, 111 varicella, 114 acute diarrheal diseases with 69 hospitalizations, 5 tuberculosis cases (including one at a capital city kindergarten), 1 mumps, and 12 viral hepatitis cases. A dengue fever cluster of two cases was identified in Chișinău residents who had vacationed in Bali; both were hospitalized, and the infections are imported. The measles confirmation followed laboratory investigations announced at a municipal health briefing on 20 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹感染が確認された児童の事例。同児童が通学している学校は衛生認可を受けていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が認められ、スクリーニング基準では重症度（複数の伝染病同時発生）、流行性（未接種児童、衛生管理不備の学校）、管理可能性（当局の対応・懸念あり）が該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはモルドバのキシナウ（Chișinău）における麻疹確認事例を主題としているが、モルドバは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。ただしバリ島（インドネシア）滞在歴のある2名のデング熱輸入症例が同時に報告されており、インドネシアは対象国リストに該当するため記載。麻疹、インフルエンザ、水痘、結核等の複数疾患が同一週に報告されており、多病因的な感染症クラスター的状況。未接種児童の存在と衛生管理不備の学校施設が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 당진시, 뎅기열 무료 확진 검사 시행 - 보도자료 | 기사 - 더팩트
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangjin City Implements Free Dengue Fever Confirmatory Tests - Press Release | Article - The Fact
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-20, Dangjin City in South Chungcheong Province, South Korea, announced free dengue fever confirmatory tests at regional hubs to prevent community transmission of imported mosquito-borne infections. With climate-driven expansion of mosquito habitats and rising Southeast Asian travel (Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia), the risk of imported dengue is increasing. Dengue fever, caused by the dengue virus, is a Class 3 legally notifiable disease. Transmission occurs via bites from infected mosquitoes and can also occur by perinatal, vertical, or blood transfusion routes. Incubation is 5–7 days; symptoms include fever, severe headache, joint pain, and rash, typically appearing 1–4 days after fever subsides. Most recover, but rare cases may progress to shock or hematemesis. Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial. Prevention emphasizes long sleeves, repellents, and bed nets. Free testing targets inbound travelers in quarantine areas who are symptomatic, those seeking tests after mosquito bites, and accompanying travelers; tests are via blood draw. Contact: Dangjin City Public Health Center Infectious Disease Response Team.

triage.headline_ja: 当진市、デング熱無料確定検査を実施 - 報道資料
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入感染リスク増加を背景とした予防的検査体制の整備が報告されている。現時点では確定患者数や地域流行の報告がないため、スクリーニング基準に部分的に該当するが情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は当진市（韓国）での検査体制整備であり、韓国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。フィリピン、インドネシア、ベトナムはリスク地域として言及されているため含めた。現時点では確定患者報告がない予防的措置のため、フルRRAは不要だが、今後の患者報告や流行拡大を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: New H4N6 Bird Flu Virus Discovered in China Shows Alarming Mammal and Human Adaptation - Thailand Medical News
article.articleSummary: H4N6 avian influenza detected in Zhejiang Province, eastern China, from migratory birds along a major migration route. One of 400 samples from a red-necked stint tested positive; the virus is a reassortant combining genes from wild-bird and poultry-origin viruses. Contains mutations linked to mammalian adaptation and can bind both avian and human-type receptors, indicating potential for cross-species infection. Laboratory tests show replication in bird and mammalian cells without prior adaptation; mouse studies show mild illness with weight loss and lung inflammation, but no lethal disease or systemic spread. Virus remains stable under moderately high temperatures and environmental persistence increases transmission risk. Widespread exposure in nearby poultry farms detected, with seroprevalence up to 100% in some flocks. Classified as low pathogenic in birds currently, but features suggesting enhanced mammal susceptibility underscore need for surveillance and farm biosecurity. No human infections reported yet; no outcomes published.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で発見された新型H4N6鳥インフルエンザウイルス、哺乳動物および人への適応の兆候を示す - タイランド メディカル ニュース
triage.triage_reason: H4N6は新規の再集合体ウイルスで、哺乳動物適応関連の変異と鳥類・人両方のレセプター結合能を有し、種間感染の可能性を示唆している。現在ヒト感染報告なしだが、養鶏場での広範な曝露と高い血清有病率が確認され、IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（流行性、管理可能性）の複数に該当する重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: H4N6は新規の再集合体ウイルスで、哺乳動物適応関連の複数の変異（mammalian adaptation mutations）を含有。マウス実験では肺炎と体重減少を示すが、致死性疾患には至らず。浙江省の養鶏場での広範な曝露と高い血清有病率（最大100%）が確認され、環境下での安定性も高い。現在ヒト感染報告なしだが、ウイルス特性と曝露状況から国際的に重要な監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: หน้าร้อน 'ตับอักเสบเอ' พุ่ง 2 เท่า คุมเข้มก่อนระบาดเป็นคลัสเตอร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the summer, Hepatitis A cases double as authorities tighten controls before the outbreak becomes a cluster.
article.articleSummary: Case numbers of Hepatitis A in Thailand doubled during the summer, with the rise by 20 April 2026 about twice that of the same period last year, concentrated in central and eastern areas including Bangkok, Chonburi, Rayong, and Chanthaburi, signaling potential cluster spread. Hepatitis A is transmitted via ingestion of fecally contaminated food or water, often from undercooked foods or unsafe ice. Early symptoms are non-specific (fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea); jaundice and dark urine may develop later. Some infections are asymptomatic but contagious, with an average incubation of about 28 days, complicating source tracing. Authorities urge proactive, expanded surveillance for clusters and stringent safety checks on food and water to curb transmission from the outset. Public guidance emphasizes eating fully cooked foods, drinking clean water, avoiding questionable ice or foods, and thorough handwashing. Prevention hinges on reducing exposure during the summer season.

triage.headline_ja: 夏季、A型肝炎患者が2倍に増加 当局はクラスター化前に厳格な管理強化
triage.triage_reason: タイで短期間にA型肝炎患者数が2倍に急増し、複数地域での集積が確認されている。糞便-経口ルート感染で公衆衛生上の重大な影響が懸念され、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: タイの複数地域（バンコク、チョンブリ、ラヨン、チャンタブリ）で同時多発的なA型肝炎患者増加が報告されており、クラスター化の前兆とみなされている。水・食物媒介感染であることから夏季の食品安全衛生問題と関連。当局の厳格な監視と予防措置強化が示唆されており、管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác 'sốt đất' - căn bệnh xuất hiện từ bùn đất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of 'soil fever' — a disease that originates from mud.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Whitmore's disease), nicknamed 'soil fever', is a rising threat in Thailand, with 732 cases and 23 deaths reported over four months, mainly among farmers exposed to soil and water. It is caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, which persists in moist soil and contaminated water and can enter the body via skin wounds, inhalation of dusty droplets after rain, or ingestion of untreated water. Symptoms range from pneumonia-like illness (fever, chills, cough, shortness of breath) to chronic TB-like illness (weight loss, cough) and skin abscesses; sepsis can cause multi-organ failure and death, with mortality up to about 40%. No vaccine exists. Treatment is intensive: several weeks of IV antibiotics, followed by roughly six months of oral maintenance to prevent relapse. Prevention emphasizes protective gear (boots, gloves), prompt wound care, and drinking safe water. High-risk groups—diabetes, chronic kidney disease, and heavy alcohol use—are especially vulnerable.

triage.headline_ja: 『土壌熱』に注意 — 泥土から発生する疾病
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準5つすべて該当。4ヶ月間で732例・23死亡、高い致死率40%、農業従事者を中心とした曝露リスク、防除困難性から早期のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはタイで急速に拡大し、4ヶ月間で732例・死亡23例と高い致死率（約40%）を示している。土壌・水環境からの感染、農業従事者の高リスク、ワクチン未開発、治療難度の高さ（数週間のIV抗生物質投与後6ヶ月の維持療法）が重大な懸念。環境媒介と人口曝露の継続性から国際拡大リスクは中程度以上と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: เตือนปชช. ระวัง ตับอักเสบเอ พบป่วยพุ่ง 2 เท่าในหน้าร้อน กระจุกตัวภาคกลาง-ตะวันออก
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public warned to beware Hepatitis A as cases double in the summer, clustered in the Central and Eastern regions.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 April 2026, Thailand's government warns that hepatitis A cases have doubled in the summer, with clusters in the Central and Eastern regions, including Bangkok, Chonburi, Rayong and Chanthaburi. The Ministry of Public Health reports ongoing surveillance and a higher incidence than the same period last year. Hepatitis A is transmitted via food and water contaminated with feces, entering the body through the mouth; initial symptoms can be fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, and later jaundice and dark urine. Some infected people are asymptomatic but contagious; the incubation period averages about 28 days, complicating source attribution. Authorities urge proactive cluster detection and strict food and water safety controls to curb local transmission. Public guidance emphasizes eating fully cooked foods, drinking clean water, avoiding questionable ice, and thorough handwashing before meals to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: A型肝炎に注意喚起 夏季に患者数が2倍に増加、中央地域と東部地域に集中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）および社会的関心（政府警告）を満たす。季節性疾患であるA型肝炎が患者数倍増で複数地域に集中し、公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: A型肝炎は水系伝播疾患であり、食中毒・水系感染の潜在的リスク。患者数が前年同期比2倍という異常増加が認識されており、タイ政府による公式警告が出されている。複数地域（バンコク、チョンブリ、ラヨン、チャンタブリ）への集中発生は地域レベルのクラスター対応が必要。重症度が明記されていないが、季節性流行パターンと食水安全対策の必要性から管理可能性判定あり。

article.articleHeadline: Jessica Iskandar Cerita Perjuangan Sembuh dari Hepatitis A
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jessica Iskandar Tells the Story of Her Struggle to Recover from Hepatitis A
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A diagnosed in Indonesian public figure Jessica Iskandar in Jakarta, Indonesia, after a severe febrile illness. She was hospitalized for intensive care due to high fever up to 39.3°C, with fever spikes, malaise, chills, and tremors over several days. Initial blood tests were inconclusive; subsequent evaluation confirmed Hepatitis A. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management centers on rest. She suspects food hygiene as the infection source and has implemented stricter kitchen practices, including thorough handwashing and wearing gloves when preparing or handling foods. Illness disrupted daily activities; she reports fatigue and weakness, and sleep disruption from nursing her 16-month-old daughter may have weakened her immune system. Location context: Thamrin area, Central Jakarta. No data on case counts beyond this individual case. Keywords: outbreak awareness, infection control, hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ジェシカ・イスカンダル、A型肝炎からの回復の苦労を語る
triage.triage_reason: 単一の著名人の感染事例であり、集団発生や公衆衛生上の広範な影響の証拠がない。疾患は既知で予防可能（A型肝炎ワクチン利用可）であり、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 著名人（Jessica Iskandar）の個人的な感染事例の報道。サマリーに集団発生やアウトブレイクの兆候なし。記事で『No data on case counts beyond this individual case』と明記。食品衛生が疑いの源であるが、これは単一事例に基づく私的な推測。公式な感染症サーベイランス情報ではなく、セレブ向けメディアからの報道。

article.articleHeadline: รัฐบาล เตือน ปชช. เฝ้าระวัง 'ตับอักเสบเอ' พบป่วยพุ่ง 2 เท่า หน้าร้อน ระบาดกทม.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government warns the public to be vigilant for Hepatitis A as cases double in the summer, with outbreaks in Bangkok.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A outbreaks are expected in the summer, with Bangkok and the Central and Eastern regions—specifically Bangkok, Chonburi, Rayong, and Chanthaburi—seeing cases that have doubled versus the same period last year. As of 20 April 2026, government health authorities are intensifying surveillance for clustered transmission. Hepatitis A spreads through food and water contaminated with feces, entering via the oral route; it can be found in undercooked foods, contaminated drinking water, or unsafe ice. Early symptoms may be non-specific (fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea) with jaundice, though some infected individuals are asymptomatic but still contagious. The incubation averages about 28 days, complicating source tracing. Authorities urge proactive case finding and strict food and water safety inspections to curb spread. Public guidance: eat thoroughly cooked food, drink clean water, avoid doubtful ice, and wash hands before meals.

triage.headline_ja: 政府が国民に『A型肝炎』に警戒するよう警告、夏場に患者数が2倍に増加、バンコクで流行
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎の症例数が前年同期比で2倍に増加し、バンコクおよび中部・東部地域での集団感染が確認されている。IHR基準において異常性・予想外性が明確で、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度と流行しやすさが該当し、タイ政府による公式な監視強化が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 당진시보건소 "뎅기열 무료 확진 받으세요"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangjin City Public Health Center: "Get a free dengue fever diagnosis."
article.articleSummary: Dangjin City in Chungcheongnam-do, South Korea, will conduct a free dengue fever testing program to prevent domestic spread of imported mosquito-borne infections. With climate-driven expansion of mosquito habitats and rising travel from Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia, dengue risk increases as visitors arrive. After fever abates, skin peeling or itching may occur; rare cases progress to shock or hematemesis. The free tests target entrants into the quarantine management area who are symptomatic, those bitten by mosquitoes who request testing, and accompanying travelers of symptomatic/positive individuals. triage.headline_ja: 当進市保健所「デング熱無料診断を受けてください」
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入症例リスク対応で検査プログラムが開始されたが、現時点では確定症例の報告がなく、予防的措置段階である。ただし対象国（フィリピン、インドネシア、ベトナム）からの入国者が関与していることから経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒71型疫情恐再起 兩大兒科醫學會頒布預防共識 | 醫藥生技 | 商情 | 經濟日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus 71 epidemic may re-emerge; two major pediatric associations issue a consensus on prevention.
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus 71 (EV71) re-emerges in Taiwan as enterovirus activity rises in Japan and Vietnam, where EV71 accounts for the majority of enteroviruses and over 80% of severe cases. The Taiwan Pediatric Infectious Diseases Society and the Taiwan Neonatology Society issue a prevention consensus. EV71 can rapidly invade the central nervous system and cause cardiopulmonary failure, with case fatality up to 20%. The 11 months–8 years age group is at highest risk, though adults can be asymptomatic carriers. Fecal-oral transmission can persist three months or longer; handwashing and environmental disinfection help but are not enough, and alcohol sanitizers are ineffective. Immune debt from COVID-19 measures heightens risk after a lull since 2019. Vaccination is urged for children 2 months through under 6 years: start before age 2 with three doses, or at 2+ with two doses; antibodies last at least five years. Vaccination aims to reduce severe disease, sequelae, mortality, and caregiver burden.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC reminds the public to scientifically prevent norovirus infection.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus is highly contagious and the main cause of acute gastroenteritis. In Beijing, the Beijing Centers for Disease Control and Prevention urges science-based prevention. After exposure, symptoms appear 12–48 hours later, are usually mild, with vomiting and diarrhea lasting 2–3 days; reinfection is possible. Prevent with strict hand hygiene, boiled water and cooked foods, washed fruits/vegetables, and avoiding raw or undercooked foods. Infected individuals should stay home to reduce transmission. For families, teach pre-meal handwashing, ensure rest and nutrition, and use separate food utensils; contaminated items should be disinfected with chlorine-based agents and utensils boiled for 30 minutes; handle materials with proper protection. Schools should implement daily health monitoring, absence records, and case tracing, and promptly report/activate alerts. Disinfect classrooms, dormitories, cafeterias, bathrooms, door handles, stair rails, sinks, toilets, and elevator buttons; train staff in disinfection and vomiting-cleanup procedures; cafeteria workers infected must report and stay off work until two consecutive negative norovirus nucleic acid tests 24 hours apart. If vomiting occurs, evacuate the area and follow guidelines, and report outbreaks immediately.

article.articleHeadline: Cientistas brasileiros usam ultrassom de alta frequência para estourar vírus da Covid-19 e do H1N1 sem danificar células humanas e apontam caminho para novos tratamentos contra dengue e zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian scientists use high-frequency ultrasound to rupture the COVID-19 and H1N1 viruses without damaging human cells and point the way to new treatments for dengue and Zika.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers from the University of São Paulo report that high-frequency ultrasound can inactivate enveloped viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 and H1N1, without harming human cells. The study, published April 17, 2026, shows acoustic resonance induces structural changes in viral particles until the envelope ruptures, described as a 'popcorn effect.' Energy coupling with virion geometry—enveloped, spherical viruses absorb energy more efficiently—drives envelope rupture without temperature or pH changes. The authors emphasize the process targets the physical envelope rather than genetics, so variants such as Omicron or Delta should not affect efficacy. This is not cavitation; it relies on 3–20 MHz ultrasound exciting internal vibrations. The researchers envision a treatment approach for enveloped viruses, with in vitro tests underway against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. This effort involved IFSC USP (São Carlos), the Virology and Inflammatory-Disease centers (Ribeirão Preto), Unesp collaborators, pharmacology faculty, and Nobel laureate Charles Rice providing fluorescent viruses for real-time visualization.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Syphilis: infectious disease specialist lists the main symptoms and risks of the disease
article.articleSummary: Brazil continues to face syphilis as a major public health challenge. The Ministry of Health’s latest epidemiological bulletin reports more than 810,000 syphilis infections in pregnant women from 2005 through June 2025. The rise in notifications and transmission underscores the need for early recognition of signs and prompt diagnosis and treatment. Syphilis is caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum and is primarily sexually transmitted through unprotected intercourse. The infection can also be transmitted from mother to child during pregnancy, leading to congenital syphilis with potentially severe complications for newborns. Early symptoms are often subtle, and many individuals live with the infection without realizing it, complicating control efforts. The article emphasizes awareness and timely care to prevent adverse outcomes for mothers and infants across Brazil.

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam atento ante propagación del serotipo SAT1 de la fiebre aftosa - Noticias Prensa Latina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam on alert over the spread of the SAT1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: SAT1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease, previously confined to Africa, is expanding into the Middle East and West Asia, according to Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture. Since March 2025, SAT1 has been reported in Iraq and has re-emerged in several Middle Eastern and Western Asian countries; China reported its first bovine cases in Gansu and Xinjiang in early April 2026. Vietnam, though not yet infected, faces a very high entry risk, especially via illegal cross-border animal transport and trade. Current Vietnamese vaccines cover serotypes O, A, and Asia1, not SAT1. If introduced, SAT1 could cause severe losses to the livestock sector, notably buffalo and cattle. Authorities should bolster surveillance, early detection, sampling, and outbreak isolation/management, and tighten controls on transport, trade, and slaughter of animals and products, especially at border zones, checkpoints, and wholesale markets.
